items.description: About Remote Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform. If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work! What this job can offer you This is a transformative time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as Principal Analyst, Marketing Analytics . As the highest-level individual contributor within our Revenue Operations team, you won't just support our strategy—you will shape it. We are looking for a visionary, highly autonomous expert to serve as the primary strategic partner to the Director of Planning and Analytics, the VP of Growth Marketing, and the broader executive leadership team. In this P5 role, you will own the long-term vision for our marketing data ecosystem, moving beyond project execution to architect frameworks that define our global marketing strategy. From pioneering next-generation predictive attribution models to unlocking the macroeconomic impact of brand equity, your governance will dictate Remote’s global investment strategy. What you bring Professional Experience: Distinguished track record in marketing analytics, business intelligence, or data science, with extensive experience specifically embedded in high-growth B2B SaaS or enterprise environments. Architect-Level Attribution: Mastery in designing, scaling, and defending complex attribution frameworks (Multi-Touch, Media Mix Modeling, and Unified Measurement) across complex, non-linear enterprise buyer journeys. Macro-Funnel Vision: Deep expertise in quantifying abstract, non-paid focus areas; a proven history of designing measurement frameworks for global brand health, organic ecosystems, Share of Voice (SoV), and long-tail market expansion. Advanced Technical Mastery: Expert-level proficiency across the modern data stack. You are comfortable writing production-grade code, architecting data models in dbt , optimizing complex Snowflake environments, and leveraging AI/automation to scale analytical workflows. Ecosystem Governance: Deep familiarity navigating and integrating enterprise CRMs and automation systems (Salesforce, HubSpot) with advanced BI ecosystems (Sigma, Tableau, Looker). Executive Gravitas & Communication: Exceptional ability to command a room of C-suite executives, transforming dense, highly technical data structures into high-impact strategic narratives that drive organizational change. Language: Professional fluency in written and spoken English. Remote-First Mindset: While experience working remotely isn't required, a strong knack for asynchronous communication, high autonomy, and self-driven documentation is highly valued. Key Responsibilities Strategic Vision & Predictive Modeling Next-Gen Attribution & MMM: Own and evolve the architectural vision for Remote’s attribution logic. Merge multi-touch attribution (MTA) with Media Mix Modeling (MMM) to build a unified view of both performance marketing and organic Top-of-the-Funnel (TOFU) streams. Predictive LTV & Budget Optimization: Architect and maintain advanced Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) and predictive churn models. Direct how these high-quality predictive signals are fed back into ad platforms and algorithmic bidding engines to maximize efficiency. Executive Planning & Capital Allocation: Partner directly with finance and marketing leadership to drive annual and quarterly planning. Own the macroeconomic forecasting models that dictate global budget allocation and ROI expectations. Global Frameworks & Data Governance Brand & Organic Quantification: Establish the global standard for measuring non-paid marketing initiatives. Build robust, defensible frameworks for Share of Voice, brand sentiment, and organic compounding to justify long-term brand investments. Macro-Funnel Optimization: Analyze the end-to-end B2B funnel—from dark social and initial awareness to closed-won enterprise revenue—identifying systemic friction points and multi-million dollar white-space opportunities. Data Strategy & Guardianship: Act as the ultimate authority on marketing data integrity. Partner with Data Engineering and RevOps to design the upstream data infrastructure, ensuring information flowing through HubSpot, Salesforce, and Snowflake remains an unassailable "single source of truth." Leadership & Innovation Organizational Multiplier & Mentorship: While this role has no initial direct reports, you will serve as the technical and strategic lead for the analytics org. You will mentor senior analysts, elevate the team's technical bar, and foster a culture of analytical excellence. AI & Automation Pioneering: Standardize the deployment of AI, machine learning, and advanced automation within the marketing analytics stack to accelerate insight generation and eliminate manual reporting overhead. Practicals You'll report to: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations Team: Revenue Operations, Revenue Planning and Analytics Team size: Individual Contributor role with massive cross-functional influence (No direct reports) Location : For this position, we welcome everyone to apply, but we will prioritize applications from locations that align with our current regional team diversification strategies. Start date: As soon as possible Application process Roughly 3.5 hours across 3 weeks Interview with recruiter Interview with future manager Interview with 2 marketing analytics team members Interview with VP, Growth Marketing Bar Raiser interview Prior employment verification check Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries. At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change. At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis. The annual salary range for this full-time position is $65,750—$184,950 USD Benefits Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits . As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters: work from anywhere flexible paid time off flexible working hours (we are async ) 16 weeks paid parental leave mental health support services stock options learning budget home office budget & IT equipment budget for local in-person social events or co-working spaces How you’ll plan your day (and life) We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async . You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs. If that sounds like something you want, apply now! How to apply Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead. Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter. We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to. At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here . Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently . Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process , including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to. Job Posted: 08/26 Location: Americas (North, Central and South America) Hi there! Zapier is hiring a Manager, Analytics & Strategy to lead our newly formed GTM Analytics team. This team is the central analytics home for Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Ops, with a mandate to deliver trusted GTM insights, improve the quality and speed of decision-making, and turn repeated questions into durable self-service analytics assets. You will manage a team of embedded analysts supporting Marketing, Sales, and Support/Customer Ops. Your team will own the day-to-day analytics interface for GTM leaders: funnel reporting, campaign performance, sales and support analytics, forecasting inputs, recurring business reviews, dashboarding, metric definitions, and urgent executive questions. This is a hands-on analytics leadership role. we're looking for someone who has deep analytics judgment, strong SQL skills, and real GTM domain expertise. You might come from a sales analytics, marketing analytics, revenue analytics, finance, or investment banking environment. The common thread is that you know how to operate with urgency, precision, and a high quality bar, and you are energized by analytics work: scoping ambiguous business questions, pressure-testing numbers, coaching people through complex GTM data questions, and delivering clear recommendations under time pressure. This is not a pure people-management role. You should be able to lean into advanced analytics, understand core statistical concepts, and guide work on experimentation, forecasting, or segmentation when the work calls for it, but the center of gravity is analytics leadership: trusted reporting, business partnership, analytical QA, stakeholder management, and building a faster, more consistent operating model for GTM data. You should also be AI-native in how you work and excited to make this team a proving ground for self-service analytics, analyst automation, and governed AI-assisted data workflows. Our Commitment to Applicants Culture and Values at Zapier Zapier Guide to Remote Work Zapier Code of Conduct Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier About You You are a hands-on analytics manager. You have 6+ years of experience in analytics, finance, revenue operations, marketing analytics, sales analytics, business operations, investment banking, or a related field. You have managed analysts or analytics-adjacent teams for at least 3 years, but you are still comfortable rolling up your sleeves to review SQL, inspect a dashboard, pressure-test assumptions, and help frame the answer. You have strong GTM analytics expertise. You understand how marketing, sales, customer operations, and revenue motions fit together. You have worked with funnels, pipeline, bookings or ARR, campaign performance, sales productivity, support performance, forecasting, attribution, segmentation, or lifecycle analytics. You know how to translate GTM questions into metrics, cuts, cohorts, and recommendations that leaders can act on. You are excellent with SQL and analytical reasoning. You read and write SQL, reason about grain and joins, identify data quality issues, and coach analysts toward cleaner, more reliable methods. You are comfortable with statistics and advanced analytics concepts such as confidence intervals, incrementality, cohorting, regression, forecasting, and experiment readouts, and you know when to partner with Data Science for heavier modeling work. You bring finance-grade rigor and urgency. You can operate in a fast-twitch environment where leaders need clear answers quickly. You know how to separate what must be directionally right today from what needs a deeper follow-up, and you keep quality high even when timelines are short. Experience in investment banking, finance, FP&A, revenue analytics, or another high-intensity analytical environment is a strong plus. You set a high bar for quality, trust, and communication. You know that GTM analytics only works when stakeholders trust the numbers. You build review mechanisms, documentation habits, and QA standards that make dashboards and analyses easier to trust. You can explain caveats without hiding behind them, and you help teams align on source-of-truth metrics across Data, Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Ops. You are an excellent manager and coach. You raise the performance of analysts through clear expectations, thoughtful feedback, technical coaching, and strong prioritization. You know how to help analysts grow and coach them through ambiguous requests and work that should be automated or moved into self-service. You are AI-native and automation-minded. You actively use modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, QA SQL, summarize stakeholder context, produce documentation, and prototype workflows. You are excited to make AI central to the team's operating model, and to turn repeated analyst workflows into governed self-service assets, AI primitives, reusable dashboards, or model improvements. You can manage across analysts and data engineers. You understand the difference between stakeholder-facing analytics and data foundation work, and you help both groups work together effectively. Things You'll Do Lead the Analytics & Strategy team, managing analysts embedded with Marketing, Sales, and Support/Customer Ops. Build a fast, trusted operating model for intake, prioritization, QA, stakeholder communication, and recurring business reviews. Coach analysts to deliver high-quality work across funnel reporting, campaign performance, sales analytics, support analytics, forecasting, segmentation, attribution, and executive readouts. Partner with GTM leaders to clarify ambiguous questions, identify the decisions at stake, and make sure the team's work leads to concrete business action. Review SQL, dashboards, metric definitions, data caveats, and analytical narratives so the team can move quickly without lowering the quality bar. Make the team the intake point for self-service and AI automation opportunities: recognize duplicate asks, separate one-off requests from repeatable workflows, and turn recurring patterns into AI primitives, governed dashboards, metric documentation, and model improvement requests that build the robot over time. Bring advanced analytics judgment to experimentation, incrementality, cohort analysis, forecasting, segmentation, and statistical readouts, while partnering with Data Science for deeper modeling needs. Leverage AI tools in your own workflow and your team's workflows, helping the team move faster while maintaining accuracy, documentation, and governance. Develop analysts through clear expectations, direct feedback, growth paths, and a strong peer learning culture. How to Apply At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional. Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process. After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter! Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws. Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here . Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com . Application Deadline: The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled. Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

items.title: Product Manager II, Wholesale Network
items.summary: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! We're looking for a Product Manager II to join our Wholesale Network team. You will own the insights and analytics features for our Wholesale Network and…
items.description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! We're looking for a Product Manager II to join our Wholesale Network team. You will own the insights and analytics features for our Wholesale Network and NuORDER platform; the tools that help brands and retailers understand how their businesses are performing and where to grow. This is a high-visibility role with direct influence on network health, brand retention, and the value proposition of Lightspeed's wholesale ecosystem. The ideal candidate thinks rigorously about data, builds strong relationships with customers and internal teams, and knows how to turn complex signals into clear product direction. You will work closely with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market partners to deliver analytics capabilities that matter to the people using them every day. If you are a dedicated problem-solver ready to make a meaningful impact at scale, this role is for you. What you’ll be doing: Define and prioritize: Own and drive the product strategy for wholesale insights and analytics, connecting your roadmap to measurable outcomes for brands, retailers, and the network. Discover and validate: Conduct ongoing discovery with brands and retailers to understand how they measure performance, where current reporting falls short, and what decisions they need better data to make. Translate complexity: Work closely with engineering and data teams to translate complex data models and reporting requirements into clear, well-scoped product direction. Measure and iterate: Define success metrics for every initiative, measure outcomes after launch, and use evidence to inform what comes next. Partner across the business: Collaborate with go-to-market, customer success, and strategic brand partners to ensure insights features are adopted, understood, and driving value. Work across the platform: Identify and manage dependencies with adjacent product surfaces, including platform data infrastructure, the buyer experience, and AI-powered wholesale capabilities. Raise the bar: Contribute to broader team and organizational objectives beyond your immediate squad. How you’ll know you’re thriving in this role: Brands and retailers can answer meaningful questions about their business using the tools you ship. Your roadmap reflects a coherent point of view, not just a list of feature requests. Engineers and designers understand the problem, feel ownership over the solution, and are not waiting for direction. You make well-reasoned tradeoffs between customer impact, data complexity, and delivery timelines. Stakeholders trust your judgment and rely on you to synthesize signal across customer research, usage data, and business context. Shipped work leads to measurable improvements in how brands and retailers engage with the network. What you need to bring: We're looking for candidates who have experience with the following: 3+ years of product management experience, with a track record of delivering data-driven or analytics-facing products in a B2B SaaS environment. Strong analytical thinking, including comfort working with KPIs, data models, and product metrics to validate hypotheses and inform decisions. Experience conducting customer discovery (interviews, surveys, usability sessions) and translating qualitative and quantitative feedback into product direction. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams in a cross-functional, distributed environment. Strong prioritization skills and comfort making tradeoffs with incomplete information. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor messages for technical teams, senior stakeholders, and customers alike. Familiarity with Agile product development practices and modern product tooling. Even better if you have, but not required: Experience building or owning reporting, BI, or dashboard products. SQL proficiency or hands-on experience working with data teams on data models and pipelines. Understanding of wholesale, retail, or merchandising workflows; how brands sell to retailers and how buyers make purchasing decisions. Familiarity with AI or recommendation system concepts as applied to business intelligence or analytics products. What's in it for you? Come live the Lightspeed experience… Lots of autonomy, flexible work culture, and the option of fully remote work Genuine career opportunities in a company that is creating new roles every day Work on a product used by thousands of brands and retailers across the wholesale industry Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact … and enjoy a range of benefits that will keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry: Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners) Flexible paid time off policy Extended healthcare benefits Health and wellness benefit of $500 per year Mental health online platform and counseling & coaching services Paid leave and assistance for new parents LinkedIn Learning license Volunteer day We know that people are more than what's on their CV. If you're unsure that you have the right profile for the role… hit the 'Apply' button and let's have a chat! Fuel your growth. Find your people. At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities Final thought... Studies show that gender-coded words significantly reduce the number of women applying. Use this link to find out if your job description is gender-neutral: http://gender-decoder.katmatfield.com/ At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skill set, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the total compensation for this position to be in the range of $115,000 TO $125,000 CAD . Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, RRSP plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off. Please note that this compensation information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within Ontario (update to BC if posted in Vancouver) and reflects the amount Lightspeed is willing to pay at the time of this posting. This role represents an existing vacancy at Lightspeed. Lightspeed uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by our recruiting and hiring teams. To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement .

items.summary: Job Description: Sharecare is a digital healthcare company that delivers software and tech-enabled services to stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to help improve care quality, drive better outcomes, and lower costs.
items.description: Job Description: Sharecare is a digital healthcare company that delivers software and tech-enabled services to stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to help improve care quality, drive better outcomes, and lower costs. Through its data-driven AI insights, evidence-based resources, and comprehensive platform – including benefits navigation, care management, home care resources, health information management, and more – Sharecare helps people easily and efficiently manage their healthcare and improve their well-being. Across its three business channels, Sharecare enables health plan sponsors, health systems and physician practices, and leading pharmaceutical brands to drive personalized and value-based care at scale. To learn more, visit . Job Summary: The Manager of Global Operations has an overall responsibility for ensuring their required tasks are performed in a consistent, timely, and highly professional manner. The Manager of Global Operations ensures objectives, principles, values, mission and foundation are represented with Global partners. The position also supports global operational activities that are focused on the achievement of company-wide operational goals. The Manager of Global Operations will do so with an emphasis on global partner engagement, relationship development, work quality, operational efficiency, long and short-term planning, customer-oriented thinking and P&L profitability. The Manager of Global Operations will work closely with the Director of Provider Global Operations, the Director of Automation and Globalization and other leaders to implement processes that will ensure exemplary member experience and market-leading performance quality. Essential Job Functions: Global Account Management Support Support Sales and Customer Service activities directed at new Clients/Prospects with RFP responses and internal/external meetings Support the identification and transition of existing Onshore clients to Global clients Support daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly Client Review calls with feedback and direction for Global Partners Global Operational Support Respond to and resolve escalated Client/Requester issues Support Inventory Management initiatives Partner with Director Provider Global Ops to create and manage goals relating to Productivity and Quality for Global Partners Quality Control – Perform Analysis and Administer Actions Plans and Training. Queue Management – Perform Analysis and Administer Corrective Actions/Training Provide Training Support to Global Partners both in country and virtually Analysis of endangered accounts and creation of action plans to address problems/account feedback Chase Activities Monitor, manage and establish new additions Communicate effectively to all CHASE team members Complete Chase Activities ahead of Deadlines. Ensure Global Partners have adequate Credentials to match inventory and production plans. If not adequate, work to resolve with client, CS, Ops teams Support Technical events that occur. Manage and Support SOP Documentation for all Global Accounts Organizational Leadership Model Sharecare ’s core values of Family, Servant Leadership, Giving Back, Compassion, Respect, Accountability and Innovation to Global Partners Operate within the Global Team to achieve goals and objectives quickly, efficiently and profitably Possess strong communication and training skills to deliver feedback and direction on how to improve Global operations Communicate essential updates to internal and external stakeholders Collect and assess documentation required to successfully transition regional operations activities to global according to deadlines set forth by Director of Provider Global Operations Measure global performance to objectives established by Director of Provider Global Operations Financial Management Continually seek new opportunities to advance Sharecare ’s transition plan and achieve expected transition milestones and targets Assist Global Partner in meeting their KPI’s for Productivity and Quality to lower overall Sharecare costs Customer Service Assist in building and strengthening global partnerships Coordinate with Operations and Client Success Manager(s) to onboard new clients and transition exiting clients to global production Specific Skills/Attributes: A thorough understanding of role requirements, including policies, procedures and processes, to include how individual work impacts the organization and its strategic and financial goals; and how tasks and projects affect the integrity of the organization’s data and information Commitment to discuss questions and recommendations about global processes and any observed variations in performing tasks to ensure a standardized approach to work and services provided Participation in education as required for corporate compliance and role-specific functions and tasks Qualifications: Minimum of 7-10 years proven success in manager or director level role Extremely team oriented High proficiency in Microsoft suite of products Outlook, Word, Powerpoint and Excel including development of pivot tables to analyze data Effectively utilizes Power BI reports to manage Global partners Ability to work well in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment while prioritizing and meeting deadlines Superior communication skills Outstanding customer service with strong negotiation skills Detail oriented, with strong analytical skills and effective problem-solving skills Ability to handle confidential materials and information in a professional manner Sharecare and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and E-Verify users. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, equal pay, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or other status protected under applicable law. items.title: Solutions Consultant
items.summary: About Wellspring Wellspring Worldwide, Inc. is a leading provider of web-based software systems for managing research, technology commercialization, and innovation operations for universities, companies, government agencies, and independent labs.
items.description: About Wellspring Wellspring Worldwide, Inc. is a leading provider of web-based software systems for managing research, technology commercialization, and innovation operations for universities, companies, government agencies, and independent labs. Founded in 2003, Wellspring has grown to serve over 500 organizations globally, including Fortune 500 companies, SMEs, hospitals, and universities. The company’s flagship products—Evolve, Astria, Sophia & Flintbox—enable organizations to manage the entire innovation lifecycle, from discovery and IP management to commercialization and knowledge transfer. The Business Development Representative (BDR) is the engine of top-of-funnel growth. You will own the full prospecting motion — from identifying and sourcing target contacts to feeding them into multi-channel outbound campaigns, nurturing prospects through early-stage conversations, and converting engagement into qualified pipeline. You will also serve as the first human touch for inbound inquiries, respond quickly to capture intent, and work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to book, run, and advance discovery calls. Your output is measured in Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and pipeline dollars delivered. Core Responsibilities As aSolutionsConsultant, you are the technical and strategic partner to our enterprise account executives across Europe. You own the "whythis mattersto you " of every deal — translating a customer's portfolio and innovation challenges into a compelling, credible vision of what Wellspring makes possible, and demonstrating it in a way that moves executive stakeholders to act. You will spend your time researching accounts deeply, running discovery with senior stakeholders, and building and delivering tailored demonstrations that tell a story rather than list capabilities.You'llwork shoulder-to-shoulder with sales, product, and services to win complex, multi-stakeholder deals inside some of the largest and most sophisticated enterprises in the world. This is a role for someone who thinks of pre-sales as a craft: part strategist, part storyteller, part domain expert. What you'll do Research accountslikean analyst.Before a single conversation, build a genuine understanding of the customer's business — their portfolio strategy, product pipeline, organizational structure, public commitments, and the pressures driving their industry. Turn that research into a hypothesis about where Wellspring creates value. Lead consultative discovery.Run discovery sessions with large, cross-functional groups and senior stakeholders. Ask the questions that surface the real problem beneath the statedone, andearn the right to be seen as an advisor rather than a vendor. Sell through storytelling.Frame every demonstration as a narrative the customer sees themselves in — anchored to their strategic priorities, their language, and their people. Make the abstract concrete and the complex simple. Build tailored demos.Design and construct bespoke demonstrations that reflect the specific customer, use case, and stakeholders — not a generic sandbox. Bring account research directly into the demo environment so what the customer sees feels built for them, because it was. Present to executives.Command a room of senior decision-makers — VPs and C-level in R&D, innovation, engineering, and IT — with credibility, clarity, and presence. Handlehard questionsin real time. Own the technical win.Lead technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and responses to RFPs/RFIs. Address security, integration, and architecture questions in partnership with product and services. Be a two-way conduit.Bring the voice of the customer back to product and go-to-marketteams, andhelp sharpen how Wellspring positions itself in the strategic portfolio management category. Travel to where the deals are.Roughly 25%travel across Europe (and occasionally beyond) for key customer meetings, workshops, and events. What you'll bring Enterprise pre-sales / solutions consulting experienceselling complex B2B SaaS to large enterprises, ideally with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. A genuine talent for storytelling and demonstration— you can take a complex platform and make it land as a clear, resonant narrative for a specific audience. Strong consultative discovery skills—you'recomfortable leading conversations with large groups and senior executives, and you listen at least as well as you present. Rigorous account research habits— you do the homework, and itshows inhow tailored and credible your engagements are. Executive presence and communication—you'repersuasive, composed, and clear in front of the most senior people in acustomer'sorganization. Comfort with technical depth— you can speak credibly about integrations, data, architecture, and security, and know when to bring in specialists. Awareness of AI and agentic architecture— youdon'tneed to be an expert, but you understand that this is where enterprise software is heading, andyou'recomfortable holding a credible conversation to that end with both technical and business stakeholders. A working understanding of API-driven workflows— how data moves from systems of record through integrations to downstream end users. Fluent English;additionalEuropean languages are a strong advantage given the customer base. Nice to have Experience inthestrategicportfolio management, innovation management, R&D management, or PPMspace is a real plus — but it isnotrequired. Ifyou'vebuilt deepenterprise SaaS solution-selling experience in an adjacent complex domain,we'llhelp youlearnthe category. Familiarity with one or more of our core verticals:chemical, consumer goods, aerospace & defense, or pharmaceutical. A background that blends technical and commercial fluency — consulting, product, ora technicaldiscipline paired with customer-facing work. Experience in Demo2Win or Value Based Sellingmethodolgies. Location & logistics Remote, based anywhere in Western Europewith reasonable access to an international airport. ~25% travelexpected for customer meetings, workshops, and events. You'llwork across time zones with a distributed European team and colleagues in North America. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Software Engineering Job Requisition ID # 25WD93193 English posting follows 25WD93193 Architecte logiciel, Plateforme de données AEC Aperçu du poste Chez Autodesk, nous sommes des pionniers dans le domaine des logiciels de conception 3D, d'ingénierie et de divertissement. Nous développons des outils qui permettent à certains des esprits les plus créatifs de la planète de résoudre des problèmes concrets. Reconnus par Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor et d'autres comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs, nous nous engageons à créer un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif où l'innovation et la créativité s'épanouissent. L'organisation Autodesk chargée des données en architecture, ingénierie et construction (AEC) est à la recherche d'un architecte logiciel expérimenté pour se joindre à l'équipe AEC Data et définir les services natifs du nuage ainsi que l'architecture des systèmes distribués qui sous-tendent le modèle de données AEC (AECDM) et les nombreux services qui l'entourent. Bien que le domaine soit celui des données, ce poste relève fondamentalement de l'architecture du nuage et des services - API, contrats de service, intégrations, conception de systèmes distribués et modèle de données connecté qui les relie entre eux - et s'étend à plusieurs équipes. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste de spécialiste en entrepôt de données ou en analyse de données. L'organisation AEC Data met en place l'infrastructure de données fondamentale qui sous-tend la vision d'Autodesk en matière de construction connectée : les plateformes, les services et les modèles de données unifiés qui couvrent l'ensemble du cycle de vie des actifs bâtis, de la conception et de la construction jusqu'à l'exploitation et à l'entretien. Ce travail permet la circulation continue des données AEC (modèles 3D, dessins 2D, suivi des problèmes, coûts, flux de capteurs, etc.) entre les produits Autodesk et les intégrations tierces. L'architecte contribuera à façonner la prochaine génération de fonctionnalités pour le nuage industriel Autodesk Forma, en collaborant avec des architectes logiciels, des experts du domaine et les équipes de produit de Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud et Autodesk Forma. Il s'agit d'un poste de contributeur senior dans un parcours d'architecture bien établi, relevant de l'architecte émérite de l'équipe AEC Data, qui occupe également le poste d'architecte logiciel principal. La responsabilité principale consiste à définir la manière dont plusieurs équipes conçoivent et développent - par le biais de normes, d'architectures de référence, d'ADR et de la gouvernance de la révision de conception - plutôt que de gérer un service unique. L'orientation précise du poste s'adapte aux points forts du candidat et aux besoins de l'organisation. Responsabilités Conception et évolution des API : Concevoir et faire évoluer les interfaces API des services AEC Data - modélisation des ressources, adressage, gestion des versions et évolution rétrocompatible, API de requête, et unification des interfaces qui se chevauchent en un seul contrat cohérent Architecture système : Définir et faire évoluer une architecture inter-équipes et native du nuage pour l'ensemble des services AEC Data; concevoir des systèmes distribués, y compris les contrats de service et les flux pilotés par les événements Conception et évolution des schémas : Concevoir, documenter et faire évoluer les schémas de données pour les entités du domaine AEC (bâtiments, infrastructures, espaces, systèmes, composantes, relations) - y compris les modèles sémantiques, les ensembles de propriétés, les systèmes de classification et les hiérarchies de relations. Assurer la gestion des versions, de la compatibilité ascendante et descendante, de la dépréciation et de la migration; maintenir le registre des schémas, les règles de validation et les contrôles de qualité Normes et gouvernance : Établir des normes, des architectures de référence et des composantes réutilisables; rédiger des propositions d'architecture et des comptes rendus de décision (ADR) pour examen par un conseil d'architecture interorganisationnel, et mener des revues de conception interéquipes Prototypage et faisabilité : Évaluer différentes orientations architecturales par la modélisation et le prototypage, afin de réduire les risques liés aux décisions clés avant leur adoption à grande échelle Mentorat et leadership technique : Encadrer les développeurs et les autres architectes sur les technologies émergentes et établies ainsi que sur les pratiques architecturales; approfondir les compétences techniques au sein des équipes Fiabilité et performance : Assurer la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance des systèmes; définir les SLO et favoriser l'observabilité (métriques, traçage, journalisation) Communication : Communiquer sur l'architecture à l'aide de vues et de diagrammes clairs (p. ex., C4) ainsi que de présentations adaptées à la haute direction; produire une documentation exhaustive et du matériel d'intégration Qualifications Minimales Baccalauréat en informatique, ou expérience équivalente Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la conception de systèmes distribués natifs du nuage, dont au moins 5 ans à un niveau d'architecte inter-équipes (architecte logiciel, développeur principal, Staff+ ou équivalent). Le titre est flexible; l'étendue de l'impact est le critère principal Expertise approfondie des services en nuage (de préférence AWS), de la conception d'API et de services, ainsi que des modèles de systèmes distribués (microservices, architecture orientée événements, résilience) Solides bases en modélisation de données et en conception de schémas - y compris les langages de définition de schémas (p. ex., JSON Schema), la gestion des versions, ainsi que la compatibilité ascendante et descendante et les stratégies d'évolution - telles qu'appliquées tant aux schémas de données autonomes qu'aux contrats d'API. Une spécialisation en architecture d'entrepôt de données ou d'analyse n'est pas requise Excellente connaissance de la conception logicielle et des modèles d'architecture Capacité démontrée à exercer une influence sans autorité hiérarchique et à favoriser la coordination entre les équipes ne relevant pas de la gestion directe du candidat Solides compétences en leadership et en mentorat, avec une expérience avérée dans l'encadrement et le développement d'équipes diversifiées et interfonctionnelles Maîtrise de la communication d'idées complexes de manière concise et convaincante, avec d'excellentes compétences verbales, écrites et de présentation auprès d'un large éventail de parties prenantes Capacité à collaborer avec une équipe internationale Qualifications Souhaitées Les qualifications souhaitées constituent un éventail de compétences plutôt qu'une liste de critères à cocher : une expertise approfondie dans quelques domaines clés importe davantage qu'une connaissance superficielle de l'ensemble d'entre eux. Les compétences émergentes en IA/apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) énumérées ci-dessous constituent un atout et peuvent être développées en cours d'emploi; elles ne sont pas des conditions préalables. Domaines clés Services en nuage : AWS et ses services clés (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Systèmes distribués : décomposition des services orientée domaine, modèles de cohérence des données (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas) et conception multi-locataires/multi-régions Conception d'API et de services : conception et évolution des API REST; GraphQL (y compris la fédération) Architecture de bases de données : relationnelles et NoSQL (p. ex., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observabilité/SRE : OpenTelemetry, traçage distribué, métriques/SLO pour les services de données Bonus Technologies sémantiques : graphes de connaissances, RDF/OWL ou graphes de propriétés - particulièrement pertinents pour l'AECDM connecté/sémantique Expertise BIM : concepts de modélisation de l'information du bâtiment (BIM), familles Revit ou systèmes de modélisation paramétrique similaires Systèmes d'IA : RAG, agents/MCP, orchestration agentique (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), observabilité des grands modèles de langage (LLM), et gouvernance des données / sécurité de l'IA (renseignements personnels identifiables [PII], injection de prompts, filtrage de contenu) IA spécifique au domaine de l'AEC : extraction BIM/IFC, traitement CAO ou de nuages de points B Architectures orientées événements B : Kafka ou Kinesis; registres de schémas (Confluent, AWS Glue); traitement exactly-once Connaissance du secteur de l'AEC : Expérience dans le secteur de l'architecture, de l'ingénierie et de la construction; connaissance des normes de l'industrie (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Une formation d'intégration au secteur est offerte ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 25WD93193 Software Architect, AEC Platform Data Position Overview At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture - APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together - spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build - through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance - rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to the candidate's strengths and organizational need. Responsibilities API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services - resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) - including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor developers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging) Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Developer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience) Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design - including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies - as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders Ability to collaborate with a global team Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. Core Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation) Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services Bonus Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs - particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering) Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). items.description: A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation ! More about our team and company: Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers We’re looking for an evidence-based, customer-centric, and innovative Product Manager to join our growing product org. As a Growth PM, you will play a key role in our product-led growth and self-serve initiatives within our Product Growth team. This team is focused on identifying where the product can do more to help customers realize value and where that value can translate into durable business growth. Your goal will be to understand the core value levers of our product and use strong growth instincts to drive activation, adoption, monetization, retention, and expansion. We believe the strongest product-led growth comes from helping customers realize value through thoughtful product experiences, not from forcing growth at the expense of customer trust. Reporting to the Growth Group Product Manager, you will build growth loops, develop hypotheses, run experiments, and turn insight into product improvements that create value for both customers and the business. You will partner closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, sales, customer success, and other cross-functional teammates to deliver meaningful outcomes. Who You Are Our ideal candidate is curious, proactive, customer-centric, and energized by solving growth problems through product. You have strong product judgment, a bias toward learning, and a demonstrated ability to turn customer insight and data into measurable impact. You have experience in product-led growth and self-serve product development, with a strong understanding of funnels, loops, lifecycle optimization, and experimentation. You are comfortable moving between strategy and execution, and you know how to use both quantitative and qualitative inputs to make sound product decisions. You are self-sufficient with data, comfortable exploring dashboards and analyzing funnels, and able to use evidence to influence priorities. You are also fluent in modern AI tools and concepts, whether through building AI-powered features or using AI to improve the quality and speed of your work. You are a strong cross-functional partner who collaborates effectively with engineering, design, research, data, marketing, sales, customer success, and other stakeholders. You care deeply about craft and customer experience, and you believe the best growth comes from helping users realize value faster and more often, not from adding friction or compromising product quality. Your Impact Drive product growth across key parts of the customer journey, including activation, adoption, monetization, retention, and expansion Build and optimize growth loops that are repeatable, scalable, and measurable Develop a deep understanding of customer behavior, funnel performance, lifecycle moments, and value realization to identify high-leverage opportunities Collaborate cross-functionally with design, engineering, data, marketing, and customer-facing teams to develop effective strategies and deliver measurable outcomes Use quantitative analysis, qualitative insight, and product judgment to inform priorities and decisions Generate and test hypotheses through thoughtful experimentation and rapid iteration Contribute to growth strategy and roadmap decisions by identifying opportunities, recommending priorities, and driving execution within your area Guide initiatives through the full product lifecycle, from discovery and prioritization through launch, analysis, and optimization Communicate progress, trade-offs, learnings, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leaders Help raise the bar for experimentation rigor, evidence-based decision-making, and product quality across the team Your Experience 3-5 years in product management, including meaningful experience in product-led growth and/or experimentation-focused roles in modern B2B SaaS environments BA/BS/MS in Computer Science, Business, Design, or related equivalent field/experience Strong quantitative business acumen and comfort using data to identify opportunities, evaluate performance, and inform decisions In-depth knowledge of product growth best practices, experimentation, and funnel analysis Passion for customer and business success, shortening time to value, and the craft of product management Strong ability to understand users and rally teams around the right problems to solve Proven track record of strong cross-functional collaboration An entrepreneurial spirit – you are self-driven, accountable, and comfortable presenting to customers, prospects, partners, and stakeholders. Egoless self-starter with great product sense, curiosity, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a growth mindset. Ability to operate both strategically and tactically, from shaping direction to driving execution and iteration Demonstrated fluency with modern AI tools and concepts, either through building AI-powered product experiences or using AI meaningfully to improve product thinking, execution, analysis, and decision-making Champion our core values of intelligence, intensity, integrity, and ownership Considered a plus Experience in fleet, automotive, transportation software, vertical SaaS, or a related space Experience writing and reading SQL Experience across multiple growth surfaces, such as onboarding, trial, adoption, monetization, or lifecycle experiences Experience with hybrid B2B PLG and SLG products Experience optimizing mature products as well as exploring zero-to-one opportunities Experience building, launching, or iterating on AI-powered product features or workflows Experience working in design-forward, product-led environments with a strong emphasis on user experience, craft, and thoughtful growth Benefits Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family) Vision insurance Incentive stock options 401(k) match of 4% PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!) 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid) FSA & HSA options Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid) Community service funds Professional development funds Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only) Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote Fleetio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will. If you have a disability or a special need that requires an accommodation to fill out the online application, please let us know by calling (205) 718-7500.

items.summary: About Lyra Health Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies,…
items.description: About Lyra Health Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. About The Role Lyra Health’s Clinical Strategy team is seeking a seasoned Senior Operations Lead for a high-impact, 6-month contract engagement focused on driving our Joint Commission (TJC) Behavioral Health Care and Human Services (BHC) accreditation readiness. This role sits at the intersection of clinical strategy, regulatory execution, and cross-functional project management. Acting as the primary project lead, you will bridge the gap between Clinical Strategy, Clinical Operations, and key cross-functional teams to drive our accreditation roadmap. This role is ideal for a senior healthcare project manager who excels at translating complex regulatory mandates or compliance standards into actionable project plans. While familiarity with Joint Commission standards is preferred, we are primarily seeking an exceptional operational lead who can quickly get up to speed on TJC requirements, partner with clinical domain experts, and drive execution. You are a self-directed player-coach who is comfortable getting "in the weeds" with workstream leads to build compliance documentation while also zooming out to present a 30,000-foot risk assessment to leadership. What You’ll Do (6-Month Scope) As a senior contractor, you will hit the ground running and lead the execution of our TJC survey readiness roadmap: Roadmap & Work Plan Ownership: Refine, maintain, and drive the master Project Work Plan for TJC Behavioral Health and Telehealth accreditation readiness, establishing clear workstream milestones across clinical and operational teams. Gap Analysis & Risk Mitigation: Continuously identify gaps, compliance risks, and cross-functional dependencies; proactively update the roadmap and implement risk mitigation strategies. Workstream Facilitation: Partner directly with workstream leads to deep-dive into specific TJC standards. Develop supporting materials and process documentation as needed. Mock Survey & Readiness Execution: Organize and project manage internal mock audits, tracer activities, and readiness drills to ensure operational teams are fully prepared for survey execution. Governance & Cross-Functional Alignment: Establish clear communication cadences across stakeholders (live working groups, asynchronous updates, and project dashboards) to drive cross-functional accountability. Executive Visibility: Develop concise, data-driven written updates for senior leadership to highlight progress, key milestones, and critical risks. Requirements: 10+ years of healthcare project management, healthcare operations, or management consulting experience, preferably within high-growth health tech or clinical environments Demonstrated track record of leading complex, cross-functional regulatory, compliance, or accreditation readiness initiatives from gap analysis through execution Exceptional strategic and project management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional peers and senior leadership without direct authority Strong written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to distill complex clinical insights and regulatory requirements into actionable executive summaries A highly organized self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and can create structure out of ambiguity Deep passion for expanding access to high-quality, evidence-based mental health care Preferred Qualifications: Direct experience or familiarity with the accreditation process (e.g., The Joint Commission, CARF, NCQA, or other), specifically within Behavioral Health Care and Human Services (BHC) or virtual/telehealth models Compensation Additional Information "We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other category protected by law. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed as per the Lyra Health Workforce Privacy Notice . Through this application, to the extent permitted by law, we will collect personal information from you including, but not limited to, your name, email address, gender identity, employment information, and phone number for the purposes of recruiting and assessing suitability, aptitude, skills, qualifications, and interests for employment with Lyra. We may also collect information about your race, ethnicity, and sexual orientation, which is considered sensitive personal information under the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) and special category data under the UK and EU GDPR. Providing this information is optional and completely voluntary, and if you provide it you consent to Lyra processing it for the purposes as described at the point of collection, for example for diversity and inclusion initiatives. If you are a California resident and would like to limit how we use this information, please use the Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information form . This information will only be retained for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, as described above. Please note that Lyra does not “sell” or “share” personal information as defined by the CPRA. Outside of the United States, for example in the EU, Switzerland and the UK, you may have the right to request access to, or a copy of, your personal information, including in a portable format; request that we delete your information from our systems; object to or restrict processing of your information; or correct inaccurate or outdated personal information in our systems. These rights may be subject to legal limitations. To exercise your data privacy rights outside of the United States, please contact globaldpo@lyrahealth.com . For more information about how we use and retain your information, please see our Workforce Privacy Notice ."

items.title: Senior Data Analyst
items.summary: OneMagnify is an AI native, platform-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity.
items.description: OneMagnify is an AI native, platform-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets. We are looking for Data Analysts with deep experience translating business requirements into technical data specifications, manipulating large datasets, and supporting various data initiatives for our client. Our Data Analysts will help design and support a set of data services and capabilities for our client's customers. They will work directly with the client's business partners and their Data Engineering and Analytics team to understand the business meaning of data and provide analysis and requirements so that data design is fully understood and the data service initiatives are in line with intended design and standards. The impact you’ll have: You are a data person with solid hands-on technical skills and great attention to detail. You enjoy taking data and turning it into a solution. You are a troubleshooter and passionate about what you do. Resourceful and relentless: independently capable of seeking information, corralling resources, and delivering results in challenging situations Collaboration and Teamwork: works with others to deliver results, contributing to the team and prioritizing group needs over individual needs Problem Solving: uses an organized and logical approach to find solutions to complex problems. Looks beyond the obvious to uncover the root cause of problems Open Communication: clearly conveys thoughts, both written and verbally, listening attentively and asking questions for clarification and understanding What you’ll do: Leverage data tools and capabilities to deliver superior service to client's customers and to advance the Data & Analytics Road Map. Conduct discovery and end-to-end data analysis to understand customer needs and to help develop plans and activities to improve data quality. Elicit, analyze, interpret business and data requirements to develop complete data product solutions, includes review data models (entity relationship diagrams, dimensional data models), ETL and business rules, data management, governance, lineage, metadata and reporting elements. Manipulate large data sets using SQL to understand patterns in the data. Perform data profiling using various tools to learn the shape of the data to help inform data quality checks and/or curation rules that need to be developed. Partner with customers in interpreting data and remediating issues when required. Collaborate with data owners, stewards to implement, maintain, enhance data governance, quality, security and privacy requirements, and related policies and standards. Prepare technical specifications for data ingestion and transformation rules. Partner with data architects to build data models for efficient consumption of data. Support the development of standards and best practices within the Data Analysis team, this includes documentation templates and agile development methodologies. What you’ll need: University or college degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or related field of study. 5+ years of relevant experience gathering and documenting requirements as well as technical specifications for data solutions. Advanced SQL scripting skills. Python knowledge is plus. Experience with AWS platform and tools associated with analytics and data (S3, Redshift, Glue). Understanding of Snowflake platform a plus. Data governance and metadata management experience (standards, format, definition, structure, tagging, transmission, manipulation, use and management of data). Understanding of Monte Carlo and Atlan. Experience in integrated marketing, digital agency, marketing services, or consulting environments preferred. Benefits We believe great work happens when people have the support and flexibility they need to thrive. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan, paid holidays, and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can take time away to recharge when you need it. We also offer additional programs focused on wellness, financial security, and professional growth. We are an equal opportunity employer We believe that Innovative ideas and solutions start with unique perspectives. That’s why we’re committed to providing every employee a workplace that’s free of discrimination and intolerance. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively search for like-minded people to join our team. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform job functions, and to receive benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. Originally posted on Himalayas
