items.description: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference? Make an impact. Join PMI. How will you make a difference to PMI? The External Communications Strategist III is an execution-first, senior individual contributor responsible for driving earned media opportunities and narrative enablement in support of PMI’s corporate reputation, thought leadership, and strategic priorities. This role sits within the PR + Communications team and operates with a high degree of autonomy, judgment, and ownership. As a Level III individual contributor, this role is expected to operate as a trusted advisor within Communications—anticipating opportunities, identifying risks, and independently driving work forward while ensuring alignment to broader narrative and reputational priorities. You will provide strategic counsel to senior stakeholders on external narrative direction, message discipline, and reputational considerations, and recommend narrative adjustments based on trends, current events, and performance insights. What you’ll bring to the role: Earned Media Strategy & Agency Partnership Collaborate with PR agency to identify story opportunities and develop timely, compelling pitch angles aligned to priority narrative beats for both B2B and consumer audiences. Maximize PR agency performance helping to sharpen briefs, challenge thinking, and ensure proactive, high-quality execution against PMI’s strategic communications goals. Partner with PR agency (and consult with internal stakeholders, including regional and functional leads) on developing strategy and positioning for global media house moments. Partner with the broader Marketing organization to source appropriate community or executive spokespeople; vet, prepare, and align them for earned media pitching and engagements. Partner with PR agency and relevant internal teams to evaluate, secure, and execute selective sponsored opportunities (e.g., panels, conferences, tentpole events) that advance PMI’s narratives and reputational goals. Identify and shape thought leadership platforms (e.g., executive bylines, strategic reports, high-impact forums, and selective partnerships) that reinforce priority narratives and differentiate PMI’s point of view. Maintain and refresh enablement kits on a regular cadence; communicate updates clearly and ensure adoption across PR, Marketing, and regional teams. Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners to align on narrative, timing, and external positioning—often without direct authority—and deliver clear recommendations (including go/no-go) in ambiguous, high-visibility situations. Maintain issues readiness for assigned narratives, including rapid response positioning, Q&A, and escalation recommendations in reputationally sensitive moments. Independently manage multiple workstreams and deadlines; maintain clear tracking of opportunities, deliverables, approvals, and outcomes. Demonstrated experience partnering with and managing PR agencies to drive earned media outcomes. Proven track record of developing and executing proactive earned media or external engagement strategies tied to corporate narratives. Experience operating with senior-level autonomy and judgment in complex, matrixed organizations. Strong earned media instincts with the ability to translate narrative strategy into executable story angles. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex topics into clear, compelling messages. High judgment and discretion; comfortable operating in reputationally sensitive areas. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Highly organized, self-directed operator with strong prioritization and follow-through. Ability to anticipate needs, proactively identify opportunities, and execute with minimal oversight. Stakeholder management is paramount; ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment on narrative direction and recommendations. Strategic, analytical mindset with the ability to use insights and reporting to optimize external communications strategy and outcomes. Proficiency in the business language for PMI (English). The chance to shape the future of how communities, creators, and brands thrive online—with the team that’s building what’s next. items.title: Registered Dietitian Contractor at Foodsmart
items.summary: About us: Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Our plat
items.description: About us: Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs. Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money. Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases. At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment: 👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards. 🚀 Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards. 🤝 One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group. Whether you’re a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food. About the role: Foodsmart is seeking compassionate and mission-driven Registered Dietitians (RDs) to join our growing Foodsmart Nutrition Network . As a Foodsmart RD, you’ll deliver virtual Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) and personalized care to members—many of whom are Medicaid participants or facing food insecurity . This is a unique opportunity to make a measurable impact on health equity—empowering individuals and families to live healthier lives through access, affordability, and education. Candidates must reside in and work within the US. Why You’ll Love Working Here Paid Onboarding: Earn $600 for completing our training program for 1099s (paid after 60 days of seeing patients) Mission with impact: Be part of a nationwide effort to make nutritious food accessible to all, including Medicaid and underserved populations. Flexibility: 100% remote with scheduling options that fit your life. Technology that empowers: Use our proprietary platform to connect with patients, track outcomes, and guide long-term success. Collaborative community: Join a supportive network of RDs who share your passion for helping people live better through food. Ongoing education : We offer CPEU webinars on a monthly basis for internal RDs. You Will: Help members stretch their food budgets and make the most of what they have Guide access to affordable, healthy groceries through our online marketplace Connect members with local food and nutrition resources Support sustainable meal planning and healthy habits for families Deliver MNT to manage or prevent chronic conditions Provide personalized virtual nutrition care via secure video and messaging You Have: Active credentialing as a Registered Dietitian by the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR) Willingness to obtain state licenses in high demand states (reimbursed by Foodsmart) Ability to work in the U.S. A computer, high speed internet and a smart phone At least 10 hours of weekly availability for patients (weekends and evenings count!) $48 - $52.80 an hour $48-$52.80 for a 1-hour visit; $12-13.20 per 15-minute unit for Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT). $52-57.20 for those bilingual in English/Spanish or English/Vietnamese ($13-14.30 per unit). About our perks: ✅ Remote-First Company ✅ Flexible & remote location Foodsmart is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our firm policy to extend equal employment and advancement opportunity to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth and/or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, marital status, disability (physical or mental) and/or a medical condition, genetic information, ancestry, veteran status or service in the uniformed services, and any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.description: Who is Boulevard? Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most. Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most . Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too. Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. We're hiring a Director of Engineering - Cloud & Reliability to lead our infrastructure transformation and establish industry leading reliability practices. This role will be instrumental in evolving Boulevard's infrastructure into a scalable, reliable, secure, and highly available platform that supports our rapid growth and customer needs across a spectrum of market segments (Small Business, Franchises, Enterprises). Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll lead a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers while driving the technical strategy for our cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, and platform capabilities. Your work will directly enable the Engineering & Data teams to deliver APIs, services, customer-facing products and data capabilities at scale by providing robust, self-service infrastructure foundations. You'll architect and implement modern infrastructure practices including containerization, infrastructure-as-code, advanced CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability systems. This role is perfect for a technical leader who wants to build the infrastructure platform that becomes the backbone of Boulevard's next phase of growth. Domains of Ownership Cloud Infrastructure & Platform - Design, implement, and maintain scalable AWS infrastructure including multi-region deployments, and infrastructure-as-code DevOps & CI/CD - Transform deployment pipelines, implement container orchestration, and enable rapid, reliable software delivery Observability & Reliability - Implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response using DataDog and related tools Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity - Establish DR infrastructure, failover systems, and business continuity planning across all Boulevard services Infrastructure Automation - Build self-service infrastructure capabilities and advanced automation using Terraform and GitOps practices Security & Compliance - Establish comprehensive security practices, manage compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2), and implement security-by-design principles Key Projects & Initiatives EKS Migration & Containerization : Lead the migration from current infrastructure to Amazon EKS, implementing container orchestration and services-ready architecture Multi-Region DR Implementation : Design and implement hot-hot disaster recovery with automated failover, load balancing, and regular testing procedures CI/CD Pipeline Transformation : Modernize deployment pipelines to support faster, more reliable deployments Advanced Observability : Enhance comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response using DataDog, enabling proactive issue detection and resolution Security Framework : Establish enterprise-grade security practices, compliance frameworks, and automation to support Data team's governance requirements Infrastructure-as-Code Evolution : Scale Terraform usage, implement GitOps practices, and create self-service infrastructure capabilities Database Scaling : Address current RDS limitations and implement scalable database architecture What you'll do here: Technical Leadership : Define and execute the long-term infrastructure and security strategy, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security as Boulevard grows Team Building : Lead, mentor, and grow a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of operational excellence Cross-functional Collaboration : Partner closely with Product, Services and Data Engineering teams to provide the infrastructure foundation for their initiatives Architecture & Design : Drive architectural decisions for cloud infrastructure, security systems, and operational practices Operational Excellence : Establish monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices that ensure high availability and performance Compliance Management : Ensure compliance with industry standards (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2) and implement security controls What you'll need to thrive: 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure and platform engineering, with 5+ years leading infrastructure teams of 5-15 engineers Deep experience with AWS services including EKS, RDS, VPC, IAM, and infrastructure automation using Terraform Proven experience migrating applications to Kubernetes/EKS and implementing container-based architectures Strong background in security practices, compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2), and security automation Experience transforming CI/CD pipelines, implementing GitOps practices, and enabling rapid software delivery Expertise with monitoring and observability tools (DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana) and implementing comprehensive alerting strategies Proven ability to work with Product Engineering, Data Engineering, and Platform Services teams to enable their technical initiatives How we'll take care of you: At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $209,500 - $270,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling. In addition to the wonderful people you’ll get to work with and challenging projects that’ll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you’re always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically. ✨ We’ve got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance. Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy. Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You’ll receive a work from home stipend every month. Family planning resources and specialized support programs. Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard. Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve. We recommend following our official LinkedIn page to stay up to date on all things Boulevard life! Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

So far, our customers have generated over $3.7 billion in…
items.description: Who we are ⬇️ Thinkific (TSX:THNC) is an award-winning learning commerce platform built for scale. By bringing together community, courses, and content with commerce, we power transformative learning experiences and give businesses everything they need to grow their revenue — all from one AI-powered platform. So far, our customers have generated over $3.7 billion in revenue and reached more than 200 million learners worldwide. The culture we're building ⭐ We've been intentional about the culture we're building and are proud to be recognized as an award-winning culture—we’re a Certified Great Place to Work , one of Canada's Best Diversity Employers , BC Top Employers , and Canada's Top Small & Medium Employers for 2026 by Canada's Top 100! Here’s what it means to work at Thinkific: We're a high-performing team on a meaningful mission, and the way we work reflects that. Thinkers are customer-obsessed and ownership-driven — we talk to customers constantly, take full accountability for outcomes, and operate with a high degree of autonomy and trust. We care deeply for each other and believe the best ideas come from honest debate, real feedback, and diverse perspectives. It's a culture built on trust, exceptional work, and genuine respect for the people around us. Who thrives here: Thinkific may be the right place if you're energized by a fast-paced environment, enjoy high autonomy, and work well with ambiguity and change. You thrive in highly collaborative teams and make the people around you better. You're results-driven, take ownership without being asked, have hard conversations even when it's uncomfortable, and celebrate diverse perspectives. AI is a tool you embrace to move faster and think bigger. Who doesn't thrive here: If you prefer highly structured environments, need to wait for clear direction to move, dislike ambiguity and change, or find direct feedback uncomfortable, Thinkific may not be the right fit. About the Role Are you energized by complex, cross-functional challenges — the kind where you’re the person who brings clarity to ambiguity, momentum to high-stakes initiatives, and trust to every room you walk into? We’re looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to join us at Thinkific. This role sits within our Program Management team inside Research & Development — a small but mighty team that operates at the heart of how Thinkific delivers. This team is a strategic force multiplier, owning complex end-to-end initiatives operating at the intersection of people, product, and AI-augmented delivery. A note from the Hiring Manager Hi! I am Afro, Manager of Program Management. I’m passionate about tackling complex cross-functional problems and excited for this person to join our team. This role is not just about organizing meetings and doing follow-ups. You will be highly engaged in owning projects end-to-end, solving interesting problems, and making meaningful decisions that contribute to Thinkific’s goals and our customers’ success. If this and a fast, AI-driven, and highly collaborative environment excites you, I can’t wait to meet you. Your goal will be to drive end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives and raise the bar on how we ship. Here’s how you’ll accomplish this: Own end-to-end delivery of high-stakes initiatives, leading programs that cut across engineering, product, data, and go-to-market teams from scoping through launch. You’ll define what “done” looks like and hold the organization accountable to it Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders at every level — engineers, product managers, executives, and external partners. You’ll surface trade-offs clearly, manage competing priorities, and keep everyone rowing in the same direction Leverage AI as a force multiplier. You already integrate AI tools into how you work — drafting status updates, synthesizing risk signals, generating meeting summaries and documentation, and accelerating decision-making Translate business objectives into executable project plans by identifying dependencies, sequencing work intelligently, and proactively flagging when scope, timeline, or resources need to shift Anticipate problems before they become blockers. You’ll build contingency plans, facilitate hard conversations early, and keep stakeholders informed Define and reinforce standards for how we ship — quality gates, rollout plans, retrospectives, and post-mortems that actually lead to change Own executive-level AI-assisted reporting with clear, opinionated status updates, risk dashboards, and decision-ready briefings The person we have in mind likely: Has 5+ years of experience in technical project management or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives in a software or SaaS environment Is genuinely technical. They don’t need to write code, but understand how software is built and what makes an architecture decision hard Is AI-fluent. They actively use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Notion AI, or similar) in their day-to-day work. They’re comfortable helping teams define guardrails for responsible AI use in workflows Is a systems thinker who holds the whole picture — dependencies, risks, resource constraints, business context — while staying sharp on the details that matter most Communicates with clarity and confidence. They write concisely, adapt their message to their audience, and can explain technical blockers in plain language Is experienced with modern delivery frameworks (Agile, Scrum, Kanban) Is data-informed and uses metrics to track progress and make decisions Loves to learn and grow. They’ve found (and keep looking for) ways to level up their skills in this field, whether that’s through formal education, gaining professional experience, or maybe even building their own business These things would also be nice, but we think you could learn them on the job: Experience in a B2B SaaS or learning product company Familiarity with evaluating and rolling out AI tooling within engineering or product teams PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification Experience managing vendor relationships or third-party integrations at scale The recruitment compensation range for this position is $93,100 – $116,400 – $139,700 CAD (this range is base salary only). Your specific compensation within this range is determined based on your job-related skills, knowledge, experience, and our internal equity assessment. The range is designed to capture the full journey from developing skills to excelling in the position. Most new hires start between the minimum and midpoint, which aligns with being fully capable in the role. The Hiring Journey An exploratory call with our Talent team An impact-focused interview with Manager, Program Management Technical Stage Stakeholder Interview with VP, Research & Development For a deeper look at our hiring process, what to expect during each step, AI guidelines, and how to prepare, visit our Candidate Hub ⭐ How we work with AI: Thinkific is an AI-forward company. We use AI tools across all teams, and our approach to hiring is no different. We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our recruitment operations, and we're committed to being transparent about how. We automate where it drives efficiency, but every hiring decision is made by a person, and a high-touch, human candidate experience always comes first. Candidates are welcome to use AI tools during the application process if desired. Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more! Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging & Accessibility: This is just our initial idea of who we’re looking for! At Thinkific, we know that people have unique career journeys. If your experience is close to what we’ve described but you feel that you might be missing a few of the requirements, please still apply! We believe in equal opportunity and are committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging across every facet of our business. We’re also committed to providing a comfortable and accessible interview experience for every candidate. If there are any accommodations our team can make throughout our hiring process (big or small), please let us know. What you can expect if you join Thinkific: An amazing team of talented, passionate, and kind Thinkers. Together, we’ve built an incredible award-winning culture —we’re a Certified Great Place to Work and have been recognized on many Great Place to Work's Best Workplaces lists for Canada, Technology, Inclusion, Women, Mental Wellness, and more! We're also one of Canada's Best Diversity Employers , BC Top Employers , and Canada's Top Small & Medium Employers for 2026 by Canada's Top 100! The chance to build, improve, and innovate on a platform that’s driving positive impact for thousands of businesses and millions of students around the world. A competitive compensation package including base salary, equity, team-wide bonuses, and an Employee Share Purchase Plan. Flexible Paid Time Off to maintain mental and physical health. Our team is encouraged to take a minimum 4 weeks of vacation, plus Thinker Holidays (extended long weekends in the summer) and time off for the December holiday season. Health Benefits and Wellness: Comprehensive benefits starting on Day 1 include health, vision, and dental coverage for you and your family, $3,000 for mental health care, a short-term health plan, and an additional $900/year health or personal spending account. Plus, family friendly benefits include generous parental leave top-ups for up to 32 weeks, as well as fertility coverage and personalized return to work options. 3 Paid Volunteer Days each year to give back to your community and support the causes you care about. Flexible Work . Choose to work from home from anywhere in Canada, at our Vancouver HQ, a co-working space, or anywhere there’s wifi for a change of scenery. AI tools for every Thinker . We’re an AI-forward team, and every employee has access to the tools they need to work smarter, faster, and make a bigger impact. ⬆️ Learning & Growth. An annual $2,000 CAD Learn and Grow fund for conferences, seminars, or courses, plus training, mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. A home office setup so you’re ready to succeed with a company-owned Macbook Pro and a budget to order a desk, chair, or any accessories to help you work comfortably and productively. A place where you can bring your whole self to work . We know that different perspectives lead to amazing ideas, more innovation, and, ultimately, our success as a company. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, beliefs, identities, and statuses. Whoever you are—we can’t wait to meet you! The Thinkific Vancouver office operates on the traditional, ancestral, and unceded territories of the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm (Musqueam), Sḵwx̱wú7mesh (Squamish), and Sel̓íl̓witulh (Tsleil-Waututh) Nations of the Coast Salish People. We encourage everyone to learn more about the original caretakers of the land that you currently occupy.

items.description: AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey. We're looking for a B2B Integrated Campaign Manager who wakes up thinking about pipeline. In this role, you'll own the strategy and hands-on execution of full-funnel, multi-channel campaigns that drive real revenue; building in HubSpot, pulling the levers, and iterating relentlessly until the numbers move. This is a fast-scaling SaaS environment where every campaign decision is made through one lens: what gets more qualified opportunities into the funnel, faster. This isn't your typical enterprise SaaS role. AssetWatch sells into the manufacturing plant floor - maintenance managers, reliability engineers, plant managers, and operations leaders who aren't scrolling LinkedIn between meetings. Reaching them requires a dual playbook: account-based tactics for executive buyers, and channel-agnostic creative for the plant-level practitioners who champion the technology. This role blends campaign strategy, cross-functional leadership, and technical campaign execution, and it demands someone who plans obsessively and operates with precision. You'll be managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously, and the throughline that keeps it all moving is your ability to build the system, run the system, and hold it accountable to pipeline. What You’ll Do: Campaign Strategy & Execution Develop and execute integrated, multi-channel campaigns to drive demand, pipeline, and revenue Translate business goals into coordinated campaigns across email, paid media, web, events, and sales outreach Own campaign execution end-to-end, including building and launching campaigns in HubSpot Marketing Automation & Campaign Operations Build, test, and deploy campaign assets in HubSpot (emails, landing pages, workflows, forms) Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to ensure proper segmentation, targeting, and timing Manage campaign workflows and triggers to support lead generation and nurture efforts Ensure campaigns are properly tracked, tagged, and attributed Cross-Functional Alignment Collaborate with product marketing, content, design, and sales to align messaging and campaign goals Work closely with RevOps to ensure Salesforce and HubSpot alignment for campaign tracking and lead flow Support sales with campaign insights, follow-up strategies, and enablement materials Performance & Optimization Define KPIs (MQLs, pipeline, conversion rates, campaign ROI) Monitor campaign performance and optimize in real time (A/B testing, messaging, timing, channels) Build and maintain campaign reporting dashboards in HubSpot Data & Compliance Ensure campaigns follow best practices for data usage, segmentation, and compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR) Maintain clean campaign data and proper attribution tracking Qualifications 4–7+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, demand generation, or integrated campaigns Hands-on experience executing campaigns in HubSpot (or similar MAP) Strong understanding of pipeline generation and SaaS funnel metrics Experience working with Salesforce CRM and marketing-sales alignment Ability to manage both strategy and execution in a fast-paced environment What Success Looks Like Campaigns consistently generate qualified pipeline and revenue Seamless execution from strategy → build → launch → optimization Strong alignment between marketing campaigns and sales outcomes Clear, reliable campaign reporting and attribution #LI-REMOTE The base salary range for this full-time position is posted below, plus equity and benefits. Variable pay, bonuses, and other cash compensation will be discussed throughout the interview process. The salary range was determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range applicable to your location during the hiring process. AssetWatch Salary Range (US) $100,000—$121,000 USD What We Offer: AssetWatch is a remote-first company that puts people at the center of everything we do. We want our team members to thrive - that’s why we offer a range of benefits and perks designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Competitive compensation package including stock options Flexible work schedule Comprehensive benefits including retirement plan match Opportunity to make a real impact every day Work with a dynamic and growing team Unlimited PTO We have a distributed team that works remotely across locations in the United States and Ontario, Canada. Collaboration within core working hours is required.

items.description: About Dutchie Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups. Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors. About This Role Dutchie is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to help drive the financial operating rhythm of the company. You’ll partner across Finance, Accounting, and business leaders to build forecasts, evaluate performance, improve planning processes, and deliver insights that influence executive decision-making. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building scalable financial infrastructure, automating manual work, and using data to tell compelling business stories. You’ll report to the Senior Director of FP&A while helping establish the next generation of planning capabilities across Dutchie. What You’ll Do Financial Planning & Forecasting Own portions of the annual operating plan, quarterly forecasts, and long-range financial planning process. Develop financial models that improve visibility into company performance and future investment decisions. Analyze monthly results, identify business drivers, and communicate actionable insights to leadership. Partner closely with Accounting to ensure accurate reporting and alignment between actuals, forecasts, and KPIs. Operational Excellence Improve and automate planning workflows using AI, modern financial tooling, and scalable processes. Identify opportunities to eliminate manual reporting through automation and self-service analytics. Help evolve executive reporting and dashboards that improve decision-making across the organization. Support board materials, leadership presentations, and strategic planning initiatives. Cross-Functional Partnership Collaborate across R&D, G&A, and Operations to understand business performance and financial impact. Become a trusted finance partner capable of simplifying complex business questions into clear financial recommendations. Help establish consistent planning disciplines as Dutchie continues to scale. What You’ll Bring 3–5 years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, or corporate finance. Advanced financial modeling and Excel skills with experience building dynamic forecasting models. Experience working in high-growth SaaS or technology environments preferred. Strong analytical curiosity and comfort working through ambiguity. Experience leveraging AI tools to automate analysis, improve workflows, and increase productivity. Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex analyses into executive-ready recommendations. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field. What You’ll Get We are targeting a starting salary of $124,000 - $166,000 based on the intended level for this role. In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes: Full medical benefits including dental and vision plans to ensure you always have the best care. Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees. Technology (hardware, software, reading materials, etc..) allowance Flexible vacation and sick days At Dutchie, we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Dutchie believes that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

items.description: About Vercel: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents. We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. About the Role: AI Gateway gives developers one place to connect applications and agents to hundreds of models with one API key. It handles provider routing and fallbacks, unifies billing and observability, and lets teams manage spend and security controls across production AI workloads. Designing this well is a systems problem. A developer should be able to choose the right model, make and verify a first request, diagnose a failed request, and configure routing, budgets, credentials, and security controls without losing sight of the application they are trying to build. The right interface might be in the dashboard, on the public model catalog, in the CLI, in an API response, or in code. You will be the Design Engineer for AI Gateway, owning product design and frontend implementation across those surfaces. You will work with customers, a Product Manager, and engineers to understand the problem, explore solutions, build the production experience, ship it, and learn from what happens after launch. AI Gateway is live, the model ecosystem changes every week, and the team can move from an observed problem to production quickly. This is a rare chance to use your product judgment, design craft, and code to shape a developer product and ship the experience yourself. You will be the design owner embedded with a Product Manager and a dedicated engineering team. You will also have the Product Design team around you for critique, collaboration, and support. AI Gateway will be your main product area, with room to pursue design-led improvements across Vercel. You will report to the Design Team. If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team. What You Will Do: Own product design and frontend implementation for meaningful parts of the journey from discovering a model to making a first successful request and operating AI in production. Design and build production experiences across the website, dashboard, CLI, and APIs, choosing the right medium for each problem. Make models, providers, credentials, routing, budgets, logs, performance, privacy, and governance understandable, then create patterns that extend across new providers, modalities, and workloads. Talk directly with customers and use product data to understand problems, define success, make tradeoffs, and improve what ships. Own quality after launch, including visual and interaction craft, accessibility, performance, resilience, instrumentation, and edge cases. Use coding agents to explore and implement ideas quickly, while testing, debugging, and taking responsibility for what ships. About You: Your work shows what you personally identified, designed, built, shipped, and learned after launch. You build production-quality web applications with React and TypeScript and can contribute confidently in a large, existing codebase. You bring strong visual and interaction craft and have made technical or data-rich products understandable without removing the control advanced users need. You can move between graphical interfaces, CLI workflows, API behavior, and implementation details, treating accessibility, performance, failure recovery, and instrumentation as part of the design. You use customer research and product data to make decisions, communicate your reasoning clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and change direction when the evidence changes. You use coding agents in your daily work, but you can explain, test, debug, and take responsibility for the code they help produce. There is no required path into this role. You may come from product design, frontend engineering, creative development, or a career that does not fit a standard title. We care about the quality of what you have shipped and the judgment behind it. Bonus If You: Have experience with developer tools, infrastructure products, model marketplaces, or observability experiences. Have worked with AI models, providers, inference platforms, guardrails, or AI application tooling. Have experience with APIs, command-line tools, structured product content, or agent-facing interfaces. Have built an application or agent with Vercel’s AI SDK or AI Gateway. See the work: AI Gateway AI Gateway documentation Browse AI models AI model leaderboards Design Engineering at Vercel Benefits: Competitive compensation package, including equity. Inclusive Healthcare Package. Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. Flexible Time Off. We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $208,000 - $312,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. items.summary: About Mozilla.org Mozilla is a mission-driven portfolio of companies and organizations working together to shape an internet that serves people and the public good. items.description: About Mozilla.org Mozilla is a mission-driven portfolio of companies and organizations working together to shape an internet that serves people and the public good. Currently, this portfolio includes: the Mozilla Foundation, which champions our mission through philanthropic risk capital; Mozilla Corporation, which makes Firefox; MZLA, which makes Thunderbird; Mozilla Ventures, which invests in responsible tech startups; Mozilla.ai, which creates open source AI developer tools; Mozilla Data Collective, a data sharing platform for human agency and fair value exchange. It also includes a handful of smaller strategic investments and Mozilla's investment reserve. Mozilla.org serves as a steward of this portfolio, managing Mozilla's assets and investments to ensure they are used to advance the vision outlined in the Mozilla Manifesto. In this role, it shapes long term strategy, allocates funding and manages Mozilla’s brands. Ultimately, its job is to enable the success of all of Mozilla’s organizations in the pursuit of the overall nonprofit mission. Over the coming years, our ambition is to actively grow the portfolio—helping existing organizations grow and mature while creating or investing in new organizations that can extend Mozilla’s reach and build long-term financial value. About the Role As a part of the Mozilla.org team, the Director, Portfolio Management sits at the intersection of portfolio planning, governance, performance management, and cross-organizational execution. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for an operator who can bring structure to complexity, translate portfolio priorities into clear plans and processes, and ensure leaders across Mozilla have the information, forums, and operating rhythms needed to make effective decisions. The role reports directly to Mozilla’s COO and, along with everyone on the Mozilla.org team, is housed within the Mozilla Management Company. Key Responsibilities Portfolio Planning & Performance Lead the portfolio planning process, integrating organizational strategies, operating plans, capital requirements and portfolio-level priorities. This includes double bottom line goal setting and capital allocation across Mozilla’s portfolio organizations. Develop and maintain the information architecture for portfolio management, including portfolio-level dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide visibility into organizational priorities, performance, risks, and dependencies. Partner with Finance and operating organization leaders to connect strategic priorities, operating plans, and resource allocation. Develop comparative analyses, benchmarks and portfolio insights. Identify trends, opportunities and areas requiring management attention. Synthesize information across the portfolio into clear insights, recommendations, and decision points for Mozilla.org leadership. Portfolio Governance & Operating Model Maintain and evolve operating frameworks, decision rights, authority matrices, and playbooks that clarify how Mozilla.org, and portfolio organizations work together. Serve as a systems thinker — constantly looking to optimize the interface between strategic ambition and operational muscle. Coordinate portfolio governance processes and help prepare materials for leadership and Board discussions. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve decision-making, and reduce unnecessary coordination across organizations. Cross-Portfolio Execution Lead or coordinate high-priority initiatives that span multiple Mozilla organizations. Translate Mozilla.org portfolio priorities into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, and delivery cadences. Surface risks and execution gaps early and work with leaders across the portfolio to resolve them. Build lightweight processes that create accountability without adding unnecessary bureaucracy. Leadership & Decision Support Serve as a strategic and operational partner to the COO and broader Mozilla.org leadership team. Design and facilitate portfolio-level operating forums and working sessions. Build trusted relationships across Mozilla’s portfolio organizations and influence effectively without relying on direct authority. What You Bring 10+ years of experience in a multi-entity holding company or an investment management, private equity, venture capital, or development finance organization. Direct prior experience in a portfolio-level role, along with experience in strategy, business operations, portfolio operations, strategic program management, or related roles. A strong connection to Mozilla’s mission and an interest in helping build an organizational model that combines mission impact with strong operational and business discipline. Familiarity with Board governance and capital allocation processes strongly preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actions. Expertise in managing qualitative and quantitative metrics tracking, dashboards, and systems thinking. Experience leading significant cross-functional initiatives involving senior stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level materials. Strong judgment and discretion when working with sensitive organizational and leadership topics. Ability to operate effectively in environments with distributed decision-making and significant stakeholder complexity. What Success Looks Like You help Mozilla.org provide an effective management and coordination layer across the Mozilla portfolio. Leaders across Mozilla understand priorities, decision rights, performance, and dependencies; portfolio-level decisions are supported by useful data and analysis; and important cross-organizational initiatives move from strategy into execution with clear ownership and accountability. Ultimately, your work helps Mozilla.org more effectively steward its organizations, resources, and mission over the long term. The Target Annual Base Salary and Pay Range for this role is between $240,000-$280,000 USD . Additionally, this role is eligible for an Annual Bonus. Applicant Privacy Notice

items.description: To learn the Hiring Ranges for this position, please select your location from the Apply Now dropdown menu. To learn more about our Hiring Range System, please click this link. Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: In the past few years, Marketing has emerged as a key vector and focus of Firefox’s growth, with Data Science playing an essential role in evaluating Marketing’s impact and developing clear strategies to ensure that success. Marketing Data Science supports Firefox through the standard fare of marketing (ongoing measurement, experimentation/lift testing, adhoc analysis, forecasting/budget optimization), and beyond that as thought leaders at Firefox in translating broad goals into clearly defined objectives and identifying the path towards succeeding in them. In this role, you will continue to build on the Marketing team’s recent successes as Firefox’s Marketing program continues to expand its footprint throughout the funnel. You’ll look to support this success in owning global data strategy for Firefox Marketing, developing new data capabilities to unlock future business growth, collaborating with Data Science counterparts in other domains domains, and working closely across marketing and adjacent cross-functional teams to translate your team’s work into practical recommendations and enablement that drive Firefox’s growth. What you’ll do: Set the strategy and roadmap for Marketing Data Science, prioritizing the highest-impact opportunities with key partners. Establish goals and measurement approaches for attribution, ROI, and campaign performance; deliver insights that improve marketing investment and outcomes. Lead and develop the team’s core capabilities across: Performance marketing: budget optimization, causal lift measurement, and conversion-signal testing Brand marketing: measurement planning and assessment of long-term and lower-funnel impact User insights: retention/LTV modeling and audience segmentation Reporting and infrastructure: build self-service dashboards, deliver ad hoc and executive reporting, and develop scalable data models and internal tools that expand our understanding of the acquisition landscape. Bring a forward-looking perspective on advertising, media innovation, and marketing analytics methods. Partner with Data Science leaders to evaluate and responsibly adopt emerging AI tools that improve team workflows and impact. What you’ll bring: 6+ years of marketing data science experience, ideally at a media agency or in-house marketing organization. Proficiency with marketing analytics tools, including Google Analytics and advertising platforms, and familiarity with modeling methods such as MMM, causal lift/synthetic control, saturation modeling, optimization, and Bayesian approaches. Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing talent, with strong stakeholder management and the ability to prioritize multiple complex workstreams. Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to tailor data-driven insights and recommendations to different audiences. What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly well-being stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla , you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose. items.description: Shape the Future on Autopilot At Autopilot , you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works. As a Product Designer , you’ll own product experiences end-to-end and help redefine what great UX means in a complex, data-driven industry. We’re building a high-performance, AI-native Fintech Operating System designed to optimize cost and revenue for digital businesses. Join us on a multi-year mission to build smarter infrastructure for commerce. Why Join Us? You’ll help build an ambitious product from the ground up, with a team that values speed, craft, and autonomy. If you’re ready to make an outsized impact in fintech, we’d love to meet you. About the Role You'll join a fast-moving team building modern, data-intensive web applications that help digital businesses operate more intelligently. This is a founding design role with strong emphasis on product logic, systems thinking, and end-to-end collaboration with engineers. 🛠️ What You'll Do Translate complex financial logic and backend systems into intuitive user flows Design dashboards, workflows, and visual systems for payments, orchestration, and automation Build and maintain our scalable design system in Figma (aligned with React components) Collaborate with engineers on real-world UX states — success, failure, pending, retry Prototype and validate features with real data and user context Participate in product discussions, shaping user journeys before pixels are drawn Uphold usability and domain accuracy as the standard for design quality 🎯 What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience designing digital products with complex logic (fintech, B2B SaaS, or data-heavy systems preferred) Strong product and systems thinking — you design for states and workflows , not just screens Deep Figma expertise (Auto Layout, Variants, Tokens, Components) Ability to translate backend logic, APIs, and data models into coherent user experiences Excellent communication and documentation skills (Linear, Figma, Slack) Comfortable working directly with engineers and iterating quickly without handoffs 🌟 Bonus Points Experience in fintech, payments, or compliance-related products Exposure to analytics or developer tooling Understanding of design-to-code workflows (React component parity, tokens) Strong interaction or motion design craft (Framer, ProtoPie, etc.) Our Hiring Process We focus on real-world collaboration, not design showreels. Here’s what to expect: Apply with LinkedIn Profile And Resume We’ll review based on the requirements above. If shortlisted, you’ll receive an email to schedule a 90-minute live design collaboration session once you’re comfortable with our pre-interview brief. 90-Minute Live Design Collaboration You’ll work with our product and engineering team on a small feature challenge — from user problem to Figma prototype. We’ll look at: How you think through logic and flows How you translate constraints into UX decisions Your interaction, hierarchy, and state management How you communicate trade-offs and rationale The session mirrors our actual workflow: accessible pragmatic collaborative Design Review & Feedback After the session, we’ll walk through your design decisions together. You’ll get feedback from our CTO and team, and discuss potential improvements or extensions to your solution. Culture & Alignment Chat A final call with CEO to discuss your long-term goals, how you work best, and whether Autopilot is the right fit for both sides. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Sr. Financial Analyst
items.summary: ABOUT RENEW CAPITALRenew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries.
items.description: ABOUT RENEW CAPITAL Renew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries. We back the bold founders using technology to pursue Africa’s greatest opportunities. With more than a decade of investing on the continent, Renew Capital is among the most active investors building Africa’s thriving private sector. Renew Capital is powered by a team of investment, finance, legal, advisory and market development professionals. Our bench includes seasoned investors, analysts, operators and ecosystem experts with deep experience scaling businesses across Africa. ROLE SUMMARY The sr. financial analyst plays a critical role in evaluating, supporting and scaling high-potential ventures across Africa. This role sits at the core of Renew Capital ’s investment process, supporting sourcing, due diligence, investment decision-making and portfolio value creation. The sr. financial analyst will work closely with investment managers, portfolio company CFOs and senior leadership, building rigorous financial models and translating complex data into clear insights that inform investment decisions. Responsibilities: The sr. financial analyst’s responsibilities are focused on three core areas: 1. Investment Analysis & Due Diligence Prepare and maintain robust financial models for pipeline and prospective investment opportunities. Analyze historical financial data, forecasts and assumptions to assess risk, return, and scalability. Evaluate capital expenditures, depreciation schedules, and capital structuring scenarios. Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis and primary and secondary research to support investment theses. Support financial and commercial due diligence processes from initial screening through investment committee review. 2. Portfolio Support & Monitoring Work directly with portfolio company finance teams on budgeting, 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts, and financial controls. Monitor portfolio company performance, identify trends, calculate key ratios, and flag risks or opportunities early. Build and maintain strong working relationships with portfolio CFOs and founders. 3. Communication & Insight Generation Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready materials for investment managers, leadership and the investment committee. Prepare presentations, memos and dashboards that communicate insights concisely. Collaborate with a diverse, distributed investment team across Africa using digital tools. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA or Master’s in Finance preferred. 6–8+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, investment analysis, private equity, venture capital, investment banking or corporate finance, with exposure to growth-stage companies. Advanced financial modeling expertise, including integrated three-statement models, valuation, scenario and sensitivity analysis and capital structuring. Strong experience supporting or leading financial and commercial due diligence processes. Proven ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, decision-ready insights for senior leadership and investment committees. Excellent Excel and financial analysis skills, with experience working with large, complex data sets. Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with investment teams, portfolio company CFOs and founders across diverse markets. CFA or other recognized investment or financial modeling credentials preferred. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS As Renew Capital continues to expand its investment activity across Africa, strong financial analysis is essential to deploying capital responsibly and supporting portfolio companies through growth and complexity. This role provides exposure to venture investing across multiple sectors and markets, with the opportunity to influence real investment outcomes. Location and Travel Opportunities: This is a remote role; however, candidates must be based in Côte d'Ivoire. About Renew Capital : We invite you to learn more about Renew Capital by visiting our website:. Application Process: Renew Capital invites qualified applicants to fill out the application form on our website here. Renew Capital is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran or disability status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Further, Renew Capital supports gender-based pay equity and is committed to compensating women and men equally, for equal work. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Full Stack Data Scientist
items.summary: About Discovered LabsDiscovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR.
items.description: About Discovered Labs Discovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR. We’re trusted by hyper-growth companies like Instantly, Granola, incident and other $10M+ ARR B2B SaaS companies who want more leads and customers from both Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT. We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing). View recent case studies at . High-level, our approach rests on three things: AI automation and workflows. We build marketing programs the way you’d build a product. Rather than burn hours a week on repetitive tasks, our in-house team of ML engineers builds workflows with custom tooling so we can focus on the high-impact work. Senior expertise. Everything is managed and elevated by a team of experts, so it’s done to a high standard and differentiated. We don’t let automation get in the way of quality. Full-stack. SEO and AEO rarely work as isolated tasks. We work across the entire funnel and multiple surfaces so we own the outcome and clients win. If you want to stand out, include a Loom showing a tool, system or deliverable you’ve built and are proud of. We’d love to see it. This role You analyse the data, work out why performance is moving and turn the result into a report the client can act on. You implement the fixes and improvements yourself with our internal tooling. “DS who owns data → analysis → decision → implementation end to end” Concretely, that means you: Analyse the data behind reports, strategy questions, client queries, technical issues and SWOTs — reconciling messy, incomplete sources into a clear picture of what's actually happening. QA via analysis - Is the rationale sound? Does the logic hold? Where's the unsupported claim? Run experiments. Design a falsifiable test, run it, and know when a result is noise rather than signal. Tie every finding to the client's business. You get to "so what, and why does this matter to their revenue," not just "here's what the data says." Own the report. Hand the client and the account strategist a decision-ready read the data, the diagnosis and the “so what?” never a raw data dump. Optimise for answer engines (AEO). Make client content the source LLMs and Google AI Overviews cite, using our internal methodology and tools, as one surface among many. Execute, not just recommend. You implement the findings yourself with our internal tooling. The analysis only counts once it's shipped. Improve the tactics and the systems. Turn a one-off finding into a repeatable process, and keep sharpening the tooling and methodology behind how the system works. Communicate it cleanly to clients , in writing and on calls, so your output needs no translation. This role is fully remote. Ideally your working hours overlap the GMT business day (we’re flexible within roughly ±4 hours). This is not for you if: You need heavy management, or you wait for perfect instructions before acting. If you spot a broken process, we expect you to fix it. Produce genius insights but don’t ship them. Insight with no execution is exactly the failure mode we screen for. The analyst who gets on the tools is the one we want. Lack experience and/or willingness to use advanced AI workflows. Prefer to spend weeks performing audits before implementation. B2B SaaS clients expect results fast and everything needs to tie to commercial impact. Not comfortable with data and analytics. We want someone who can diagnose the why behind performance and back it with evidence. What’s in it for you Benefits $30,000 -$50,000 annual salary depending on relevant skills and experience Fully remote position. (Ideally flexible within roughly ±4 hours GMT ) Room to grow. We’re small but growing, which means real opportunity, including a senior track with no people management required. Paid leave and autonomy to perform your role. The best in-house SEO/AEO tools i.e. ML/AI and data science tooling , built by top engineers, at your disposal. How you’ll spend your time A rough split; it flexes month to month with what each account needs. 40% — Implementing and shipping. Producing and shipping the week’s work across your accounts: technical fixes, on-page, content refreshes, internal linking, off-page and AEO, all verified at source before it goes out. 30% — Analysing, diagnosing and measuring. Getting into the numbers to understand cause and effect, designing and running experiments, and measuring what actually moved after a change. 15% — Reporting and client communication. Owning the client-facing report, being present on calls to walk through the diagnosis, staying close in day-to-day client Slack, and giving the account owner the read behind the story they lead. 15% — Building and evolving the methodology. Sharpening your own skills as search and AI assistants keep changing, and constantly improving the tooling, templates and process behind how the team works. Requirements This role owns the full loop end to end, analyse → explain → implement → report. You don't hand off execution: you analyse it, you build it, you ship it. High agency and a builder's instinct are the two traits we weight above everything, including domain knowledge. High agency covers execution and tempo; builder covers coding, AI workflows, and evolving the methodology. Strong analytical and quantitative background: you reconcile messy, incomplete data (GSC exports, rank trackers, partial client analytics not clean warehouse tables), design falsifiable experiments, and reason to a root cause with evidence, never inventing a cause where the data is silent. Demonstrated evidence of shipping a time your analysis changed what a business did, and you implemented at least part of it yourself. Insight without execution is exactly the wrong fit for this seat. You're AI-native and have built something with it: a side project, agent, scraper, or internal tool. You use AI tools daily as a workflow multiplier (briefs, clustering, audit summarisation, scraping) and still own the final, validated output. You build workflows, not just prompts and we take portfolio over claims. Experiment design and statistical rigour : you design a test, run it, and know when a result is noise. Systems thinking: you improve the tactic and improve the system colonbehind it, turning a one-off finding into a repeatable process. Commercial curiosity: you get to "so what?" unprompted, asking about the client's business model and KPIs, and land every finding as a business consequence revenue, pipeline, or cost not just a metric movement. Strong written and verbal English , with the ability to convey findings cleanly to non-technical stakeholders. Reports and QA rationale go straight to clients; the analysis only counts once a client understands it and acts on it. Nice-to-haves (not required) Experience with SEO/analytics tooling (GSC, GA4, Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog). If you don’t have it, we’ll ramp you this is teachable. Client-facing experience, and commercial awareness. Familiarity with B2B SaaS. Culture fit You should ideally believe: Search has fundamentally changed. Google and backlinks still matter but are no longer the full picture — AI search is a new frontier and you’re excited about the shift. AI is a force multiplier, not a crutch. You’re actively using AI daily and building workflows, not just typing into a chat box. Speed and quality are both achievable. Everyone here operates at a fast pace, is reliable and takes extreme ownership. There are no passengers at Discovered Labs. You’ll thrive here if: you get energy from excellent work that makes clients successful, you see gaps in processes and fix them without being asked, and you move fast while proactively communicating. You won’t thrive here if: you need heavy management, you wait for perfect instructions, or you think SEO is still just about keywords and links. We look forward to seeing your application. Originally posted on Himalayas
