items.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role: As a founding Strategic Sales Director for Iberia, you will own 8-12 of the largest strategic accounts across Spain and/or Portugal — IBEX35-caliber banking, telco, insurance, utilities, and travel enterprises. You'll run complex, multi-level sales cycles from 6 to 18 months, build both the business case and the technical win alongside your Solutions Consultant, and drive long-term land-and-expand strategy while continuing to bring in new logos. As part of the founding Iberia team, you'll work alongside a 10-person Madrid-based org (SDR, SC, and Customer Success) and help shape the region's go-to-market strategy from the ground up. Responsibilities: Manage a portfolio of 8-12 top strategic accounts in Spain and/or Portugal Generate your own pipeline — Cresta drives strong inbound, but Strategic AEs are expected to self-source roughly 50% of pipeline Orchestrate complex, multi-level sales cycles (6-18 months) across buying committees, procurement, legal, and security Build the business case and the technical win in partnership with your Solutions Consultant and extended team Drive land-and-expand strategy with a long-term vision for each account, while continuing to prioritize new-logo acquisition Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience Qualifications We Value: 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, including at least 4 years as a quota-carrying individual contributor selling into large Spanish enterprises (IBEX35 or equivalent: banking, telco, insurance, utilities, travel) Verified track record closing deals of €500K+ ARR / €1M+ TCV, including at least one deal exceeding €1M TCV at an IBEX35-caliber account New-logo hunting as your primary motion — majority of attainment historically from net-new logos rather than installed-base expansion Experience navigating complex 6-18 month cycles, including RFPs, buying committees, and procurement/legal/security review in regulated industries Existing C-level/VP network within Spanish enterprise accounts Nice-to-Have: CX / contact center / conversational AI domain exposure (CCaaS, WEM, analytics, virtual agents) Experience opening a market or territory from zero for a hyper-growth vendor Experience co-selling with SIs and channel partners (e.g. Accenture, Telefónica Tech, Sabio-type ecosystem) Familiarity with Ley SAC and Spanish regulatory drivers in customer service MEDDPICC (or equivalent) formally trained Language & Travel: Native or negotiation-grade Spanish, fluent English; Portuguese is a strong plus Madrid-based, with travel across the Iberian Peninsula expected Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced Compensation at Cresta Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family. This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed. OTE Range: TBD (comp benchmarking in progress) + Offers Equity We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. items.description: Requisition #: 18836 Functional Area: Consulting; Workplace Safety Employment Type: Independent Contractor Work Options: Independent Contractor - varies based on Scope of Work #LI-Remote Work Hours: As needed to fulfill contract requirements Posting J. J. Keller & Associates, Inc. is a North American organization providing innovative safety and regulatory compliance guidance and solutions to organizations across the U. S. and Canada. For over 70 years, organizations of all sizes have relied on J. J. Keller to help them create safe work environments for their employees and comply with ever-changing regulations. As we look to expand our service offerings, we are seeking to add an Independent Contractor to our Workplace Safety Consulting practice who has subject matter expertise related to OSHA General Industry . This opportunity is for an Independent Contractor only and does not constitute an employment relationship. Independent Contractors must reside in the U. S. and be legally authorized to perform services within the United States. To be considered as an Independent Contractor, individuals must: Operate as an independent safety consulting business (e.g., sole proprietor, incorporated entity, or equivalent) Provide services to multiple clients and maintain a non-exclusive consulting practice Supply their own tools, methodologies, instructional materials, and business processes necessary to deliver services Be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business-related expenses Provide their own computer, equipment, and tools necessary to perform services Maintain appropriate professional liability coverage, as required under the contractual agreement Travel requirements vary based on client engagements, audit needs, and training delivery, and are defined by project or statement of work. Types of Services Requested Provides expert advice, safety consulting and educational services to J. J. Keller clients on construction safety and health matters through onsite engagements, off-site locations, and/or internet-based delivery methods in accordance with defined project scope. Designs, develops, documents, and maintains training curriculum and instructional materials for general and client-specific applications. Conducts safety audits, inspections, and risk assessments, based on applicable regulatory standards and client requirements related to excavation, fall protection, scaffolding, trenching, heavy equipment, electrical safety, and roadway work zones. Monitors relevant regulatory and compliance applicable to the scope of service and incorporate changes into deliverables and training content as appropriate. Communicates regulatory updates, recommendations, and findings to designated client contacts through reports, briefings, or presentations. Provides advisory support to interpret regulatory requirements and practical application, without assuming responsibility for client compliance enforcement or ongoing operational oversight. Qualifications Experience: Extensive experience in construction safety and health, with a strong focus on OSHA General Industry. Demonstrated expertise providing safety consulting, regulatory advisory, auditing, and training services to commercial or industrial clients. Other Skills/Qualifications : Strong understanding of federal, state, and local safety regulations. Proven history of providing independent safety consulting services within consulting and/or complex corporate environments. Proficiency using business productivity tools (MS Office suite) necessary to deliver reports, presentations, and training materials. Excellent communication skills – verbal, written and presentation Demonstrated ability to work effectively with client representatives at all levels. Maintains a high level of regulatory expertise. Strong working knowledge of sales, marketing, and finance concepts related to operating an independent consulting practice. Ability to legally operate a motor vehicle to perform required services. Physical Requirements Work is performed primarily in a standard office environment. Work involves operation of personal computer equipment for extended periods of time. Frequent travel to offsite offices, customer sites and/or industry and training events is required. Travel Requirements: 80% We Protect People & The Businesses They Run™ J. J. Keller History: November 1, 2023, marked 70 years of business for J. J. Keller & Associates, Inc. Click HERE to take a tour through three generations of this family-owned business – from our founding as a one-man consulting firm through decades of delivering on our purpose of protecting people and the businesses they run. If you experience system-related issues or need assistance with the online application, please call (920) 720-7700. Professional Referral Program: Not the right role for you, but know someone who could be a great fit? Click HERE to refer them to us through our Professional Referral Program and you will earn a cash payment if your referral is hired. J. J. Keller & Associates, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

items.title: Subject Matter Expert – Medicine & Biostatistics Chart Analysis
items.summary: Role Title: Subject Matter Expert – Medicine & Biostatistics Chart Analysis Role Type: ContractorLocation: Remotemicro1 is selecting Subject Matter Expert – Medicine & Biostatistics Chart Analysis professionals to contribute advanced domain insights to a customer's project.
items.description: Role Title: Subject Matter Expert – Medicine & Biostatistics Chart Analysis Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is selecting Subject Matter Expert – Medicine & Biostatistics Chart Analysis professionals to contribute advanced domain insights to a customer's project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Interpret complex medical and biostatistical charts, including Kaplan-Meier curves, forest plots, ROC curves, hazard-ratio plots, and similar clinical or epidemiological visualizations, with professional accuracy. Draft clear, objective, and multi-step analytical questions based on intricate visual data, requiring quantitative reasoning and detailed interpretation beyond basic data extraction. Deliver precise, unambiguous answers accompanied by comprehensive, step-by-step explanations in expert-level written English, outlining calculations, statistical inferences, or clinical judgment. Apply domain-specific medical and biostatistical terminology, ensuring accurate reference to units, scales, confidence intervals, p-values, and annotations across all deliverables. Design reasoning tasks that emphasize graphical interpretation, comparisons, calculations, trend analysis, and data interpolation, while strictly avoiding subjective or ambiguous phrasing. Collaborate remotely and reliably with project teams via written and verbal channels, actively incorporating feedback and upholding consistent, high-quality communication. Produce verifiable reasoning assignments that directly support training and evaluation use cases for advanced AI models. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's, Master's, or Doctoral degree (MD, MPH, PhD, or equivalent) in Medicine, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Public Health, or a closely related quantitative or clinical field. Two or more years of professional, academic, or research experience interpreting clinical trial data, survival analyses, or epidemiological visualizations. Demonstrated advanced skill with axes, legends, units, scales, confidence intervals, and statistical annotations in medical charts (e.g., Kaplan-Meier, forest, ROC curves). Proven ability to clearly articulate analytical processes and provide clinical or biostatistical reasoning in high-quality written and spoken English. Bilingual proficiency in English and, ideally, a second language relevant to medical or research practice. Experience in technical documentation, scientific publishing, assessment or analytical task development, or structured data annotation for clinical, research, or AI-focused projects. Background in producing benchmark questions, technical reports, or data annotation tasks for medical, clinical research, or AI model development engagements. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Brief CC.Talent is looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable Specialist to join the accounting team of a growing company in the luxury technology and home automation industry. The ideal candidate will have strong Accounts Receivable experience, advanced QuickBooks Online skills, excellent attention to detail, and a proactive approach to improving financial processes and workflows. About the Client Our client is a premier luxury technology integration company specializing in residential audio/video, lighting control, motorized window treatments, networking, and home automation solutions. They serve discerning clients who expect high-quality experiences, innovative technology, and exceptional service. The company has a strong focus on continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and operational excellence, encouraging team members to identify better ways of working and contribute to the overall growth of the business. Responsibilities Accounts Receivable Generate and distribute client invoices accurately and on schedule. Monitor outstanding accounts and proactively manage collections. Follow up professionally and consistently on overdue invoices. Maintain accurate client account records and payment histories. Process and correctly apply client payments. Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable processes and collections. Experience with invoicing, payment processing, reconciliations, and collections. Strong Microsoft Excel and data management skills. Comfortable working with cloud-based business systems and learning new technologies. Experience with D-Tools Cloud and Microsoft 365 is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to investigate discrepancies and identify root causes. Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial information. A proactive mindset with an interest in process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency. Highlights Accounts Receivable Specialist Originally posted on Himalayas

Our mission is to solve one of humanity’s most complex coordination tasks, helping to shepherd the next generation of drugs to market much faster.We are looking for a freelance/contract data specialist for a manual life science dataset curation project. This is a remote role perfect for an experienced professional available for an immediate, short-term engagement. What you'll do: Review and clean datasets related to the drug development pipeline. Identify and correct errors and inconsistencies. Ensure data is standardized to competitive intelligence / business development standards. The Role: Pay: ~$50/hour Hours: 20-40 hours/week (flexible schedule) Duration: Short-term contract, expected to last 2-3 weeks. Requirements: PhD or Master's in biotech or a related life science field. Familiarity with the drug development pipeline (e.g., reads equity research for fun) High attention to detail is essential. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Role Title: Revenue Operations Specialist (SaaS)Role Type: ContractorLocation: Remotemicro1 is engaging Revenue Operations Specialists (SaaS) to contribute to a customer's project focused on elevating operational effectiveness and data integrity in complex SaaS business environments.
items.description: Role Title: Revenue Operations Specialist (SaaS) Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Revenue Operations Specialists (SaaS) to contribute to a customer's project focused on elevating operational effectiveness and data integrity in complex SaaS business environments. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is ideally suited for a professional with hands-on ownership of CRM systems and adjacent SaaS revenue tools, especially in regulated or multi-product contexts where operational judgment and clear communication are essential. Scope of Work: Assess and refine CRM data models to align with evolving sales, customer success, and revenue operations requirements. Identify, arbitrate, and document resolutions for conflicting operational policies, explaining logical choices and tradeoffs. Design and validate compliance-constrained workflows for SaaS revenue processes, ensuring adherence to vertical-specific regulations. Diagnose and address gaps in revenue data integrity, supporting accurate, actionable reporting and analytics. Deliver detailed process walk-throughs based on personal system configuration experience, highlighting decision points and lessons learned. Contribute written and verbal insights for scenario-based operational training tasks in collaboration with project stakeholders. Recommend system improvements with a focus on scalability, compliance, and cross-functional alignment. Preferred Qualifications 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience in SaaS revenue, sales, customer success, or implementation operations (not adjacent or management-only exposure). Proven CRM ownership (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) with configuration experience, plus at least two additional tools such as billing, CPQ, ticketing, or project tracking. Demonstrated ability to resolve policy conflicts and explain operational tradeoffs in high-complexity, high-compliance environments (fintech, healthtech, insurtech, or similar fields strongly preferred). Strong operational judgment: adept at making and justifying process decisions where rules, regulations, or business needs intersect. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, capable of documenting logic and collaborating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience in process design for regulated industries or multi-product SaaS implementations, with a focus on compliance and reporting accuracy. Comfort navigating ambiguity, prioritizing what to change versus what to leave stable, and articulating the rationale behind each decision. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: চাকরির বিবরণ আপনি কি বিস্তারিত বিষয়ে মনোযোগী ব্যক্তি যার গবেষণার প্রতি আবেগ এবং জাতীয় এবং স্থানীয় ভূগোলের ভালো বোঝাপড়া আছে? এই ফ্রিল্যান্স সুযোগ আপনাকে নিজের গতিতে এবং নিজের বাড়ির আরামে কাজ করতে দেয়। একজন অনলাইন ডেটা বিশ্লেষকের একটি দিন: এই ভূমিকায়, আপনি একটি প্রকল্পে কাজ করবেন যা বিশ্বব্যাপী লক্ষ লক্ষ মানুষ দ্বারা ব্যবহৃত ডিজিটাল মানচিত্রের বিষয়বস্তু এবং গুণমান উন্নত করার লক্ষ্যে রয়েছে। ওয়েব-ভিত্তিক পরিবেশে গবেষণা এবং মূল্যায়ন কাজ সম্পন্ন করা যেমন ডেটা যাচাই এবং তুলনা করা, এবং তথ্যের প্রাসঙ্গিকতা ও নির্ভুলতা নির্ধারণ করা। আজই আমাদের সাথে যোগ দিন এবং একটি গতিশীল এবং উদ্ভাবনী দলের অংশ হন যা বিশ্বে পরিবর্তন আনছে! TELUS Digital AI Community আমাদের বৈশ্বিক AI কমিউনিটি হলো বিভিন্ন পটভূমির দশ লক্ষেরও বেশি অবদানকারীর একটি প্রাণবন্ত নেটওয়ার্ক। তাঁরা গ্রাহকদের উন্নতমানের AI মডেল তৈরির লক্ষ্যে কন্টেন্ট সংগ্রহ, পরিমার্জন, প্রশিক্ষণ, অনুবাদ এবং স্থানীয়করণের কাজে সহায়তা করেন। আমাদের ক্রমবর্ধমান এই কমিউনিটির অংশ হোন এবং বিশ্বের শীর্ষস্থানীয় কিছু ব্র্যান্ডের ব্যবহৃত উদ্ভাবনী AI প্রযুক্তির উন্নয়নে অবদান রাখুন। যোগ্যতার পথ এই ভূমিকায় আবেদন করার জন্য কোন পূর্ববর্তী পেশাদার অভিজ্ঞতার প্রয়োজন নেই, তবে এই প্রকল্পে কাজ করার জন্য আপনাকে মৌলিক প্রয়োজনীয়তাগুলি পূরণ করতে এবং একটি মান মূল্যায়ন প্রক্রিয়ার মধ্য দিয়ে যেতে হবে। এটি একটি অংশ-সময়ের দীর্ঘমেয়াদী প্রকল্প এবং আপনার কাজ এই চুক্তির শর্তাবলীতে আমাদের মান গুণমান নিশ্চিতকরণ পরীক্ষার সাপেক্ষে থাকবে। মৌলিক প্রয়োজনীয়তা বাংলা এবং ইংরেজি ভাষায় সম্পূর্ণ পেশাদার দক্ষতা গত ৫ বছর ধরে ভারতের বাসিন্দা থাকা এবং ভারতের বর্তমান এবং ঐতিহাসিক ব্যবসা, মিডিয়া, ক্রীড়া, সংবাদ, সোশ্যাল মিডিয়া এবং সাংস্কৃতিক বিষয়ে পরিচিত থাকা নির্দেশিকা অনুসরণ করার এবং সার্চ ইঞ্জিন, অনলাইন মানচিত্র এবং ওয়েবসাইট তথ্য ব্যবহার করে অনলাইন গবেষণা পরিচালনা করার ক্ষমতা মানচিত্র, সংবাদ, অডিও কাজ এবং প্রাসঙ্গিকতা সহ বিভিন্ন ধরনের কাজ জুড়ে কাজ করার নমনীয়তা প্রতিদিন ব্রডব্যান্ড ইন্টারনেট সংযোগ, কম্পিউটার এবং প্রাসঙ্গিক সফটওয়্যার অ্যাক্সেস মূল্যায়ন প্রোগ্রামে নিয়োগ করার জন্য, আপনি একটি খোলা বই যোগ্যতা পরীক্ষা নেবেন যা আপনার এই অবস্থানের জন্য উপযুক্ততা নির্ধারণ করবে এবং আইডি যাচাইকরণ সম্পন্ন করবেন। আমাদের দল আপনার যোগ্যতা পরীক্ষার আগে নির্দেশিকা এবং শেখার উপকরণ প্রদান করবে। আপনাকে নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের মধ্যে পরীক্ষা সম্পন্ন করতে হবে কিন্তু আপনার সুবিধা অনুযায়ী। এখানে আবেদন করুন: স্বাধীন ঠিকাদার সম্পর্ক এই সুযোগটি একজন স্বতন্ত্র ঠিকাদার (independent contractor) হিসেবে কাজ করার ভিত্তিতে প্রদান করা হচ্ছে। প্রকল্পের প্রাপ্যতা ও গুণগত মানের শর্ত সাপেক্ষে, অবদানকারীরা কখন এবং কতটা কাজ করবেন, তা নির্ধারণ করার স্বাধীনতা তাদের রয়েছে। এই সুযোগটিকে TELUS Digital-এর সাথে কোনো কর্মসংস্থান বা চাকরির সম্পর্ক হিসেবে গণ্য করা যাবে না। Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ವಿವರಣೆ ನೀವು ವಿವರಗಳಿಗೆ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೇ, ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಗಾಧ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕತೆಯ ಉತ್ತಮ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ? ಈ ಫ್ರೀಲ್ಯಾನ್ಸ್ ಅವಕಾಶವು ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸ್ವಂತ ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಘರದ ಸುವಿಧೆಯಿಂದ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಲು ಅನುಮತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಡೇಟಾ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಕನ ಜೀವನದ ಒಂದು ದಿನ: ಈ ಪಾತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ನೀವು ವಿಶ್ವಾದ್ಯಂತ ಲಕ್ಷಲಕ್ಷ ಜನರು ಬಳಸುವ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ವಿಷಯವಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಗುಣಮಾನವನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸುವ ಗುರಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವಿರಿ. ವೆಬ್-ಆಧಾರಿತ ಪರಿಸರದಲ್ಲಿ ಡೇಟಾ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಮತ್ತು ತುಲನೆ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಾಸಂಗಿಕತೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಖುರತೆ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುವುದುಹೀಗಿನ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸುವುದು. ಇಂದು ನಮ್ಮೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಆನುವುತ್ತಿರುವ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಶೀಲ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಭಾವನೀ ಹೃದಯದ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರಿ! TELUS Digital AI Community ನಮ್ಮ ಜಾಗತಿಕ AI ಸಮುದಾಯವು ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಗಳಿರುವ ಹತ್ತು ಲಕ್ಷಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೊಡುಗೆದಾರರ ಒಂದು ಕ್ರಿಯಾಶೀಲ ಜಾಲವಾಗಿದೆ. ಉತ್ತಮ AI ಮಾದರಿಗಳನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸಲು ಅಗತ್ಯವಿರುವ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು (content) ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಲು, ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಪಡಿಸಲು, ತರಬೇತಿ ನೀಡಲು, ಅನುವಾದಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳೀಯಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಇವರು ಗ್ರಾಹಕರಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ನಮ್ಮ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಮುದಾಯದ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವದ ಕೆಲವು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಗಳು ಬಳಸುವ ನವೀನ AI ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನಗಳ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೊಡುಗೆಯನ್ನು ನೀಡಿ. ಯೋಗ್ಯತೆ ಹಾದಿ ಈ ಪಾತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಲು ಯಾವುದೇ ಹಿಂದಿನ ವೃತ್ತಿಮಾನ ಅನುಭವದ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ, ಆದಾಗ್ಯೂ ಈ ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಲು ನೀವು ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸಬೇಕು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಮೂಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಹೋಗಬೇಕು. ಇದು ಒಂದು ಅರ್ಧ-ಸಮಯದ ದೀರ್ಘಾವಧಿಯ ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸವು ಈ ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ ಅವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ಖಚಿತ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಳಪಟ್ಟಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಗಳು ಕನ್ನಡ ಮತ್ತು ಇಂಗ್ರಜಿ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ವೃತ್ತಿಮಾನ ನಿಪುಣತೆ ಕಳೆದ 5 ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿವಾಸಿ ಆಗಿರುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಮತ್ತು ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ, ಮಾಧ್ಯಮ, ಕ್ರೀಡೆ, ಸುದ್ದಿ, ಸೋಶ್ಯಲ್ ಮೀಡಿಯಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಪರಿಚಯವಿರುವುದು ಮಾರ್ಗನಿರ್ದೇಶನಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಚ್ ಇಂಜಿನ್‌ಗಳು, ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಬಳಸಿ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ನಡೆಸಲು ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು, ಸುದ್ದಿ, ಆಡಿಯೋ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತತೆ ಸಹ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಕಾರ್ಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರಗಳಾದ್ಯಂತ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಲು ನಮ್ಯತೆ ಬ್ರಾಡ್‌ಬ್যಾಂಡ್ ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ, ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಸಾಫ್ಟ್‌ವೇರ್‌ಗೆ ದೈನಿಕ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಮೂಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಯೋಜಿತರಾಗುವುದಕ್ಕೆ, ನೀವು ಒಂದು ಓಪನ್ ಬುಕ್ ಯೋಗ್ಯತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೀರಿ ಅದು ಆ ಪಾತ್ರದ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಐಡಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೀರಿ. ನಮ್ಮ ತಂಡವು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಯೋಗ್ಯತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಮೊದಲು ನಿಮಗೆ ಕೊಡುಗೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಅವಕಾಶವು TELUS Digital ಜೊತೆಗಿನ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಮತ್ತು ಇದನ್ನು ಹಾಗೆ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬಾರದು. items.title: Identity Trust & Fraud Intelligence Specialist - Intermediate (AI Community)
items.summary: Job description About the Role: At TELUS Digital, we are building the "Shield of Trust" for global digital identity.
items.description: Job description About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are building the "Shield of Trust" for global digital identity. You will join an elite freelance pool focused on training AI to detect fraud, verify identity documents, and maintain the highest standards of KYC (Know Your Customer) . Your role is to teach AI models how to distinguish between a real human and a high-fidelity synthetic mask, and between a genuine passport and a masterfully forged document. At TELUS, you ensure that digital access remains secure for everyone. Key Responsibilities: Document Authenticity Auditing: Review and annotate high-resolution scans of international IDs (Passports, Visas, Licenses) to identify microscopic markers of forgery or tampering. Liveness & Biometric Verification: Evaluate "Liveness" test data to help AI detect deepfakes, playback attacks, or 3D masks during the face-matching process. OCR & PII Data Validation: Audit the accuracy of AI-extracted data (Name, DOB, Expiry) from documents, ensuring the model handles different scripts and localized document formats. Adversarial Fraud Testing: Act as a "Fraudster" by testing the system with edge-case documents and synthetic identities to find vulnerabilities in the KYC model. Qualification path Mandatory Qualifications: Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Cybersecurity, Criminal Justice, Forensic Science, or Information Security. Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory to identify localized document types and regional identity nuances. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English. Analytical Eye: Exceptional attention to detail, specifically in identifying pixel-level anomalies in digital images. Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. Apply Here: ﻿ Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Contact email Originally posted on Himalayas

We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and . We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone,﻿ and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. The opportunity We are seeking a Talent Acquisition Partner : an individual who is passionate about enabling a product-led organisation by engaging and hiring talented members across all different Business areas. What you will do: Own hiring end-to-end, from intake through offer, across Product, Tech, and Business, with Product as your primary area of depth. Work as a peer to hiring managers and Product leadership: run intakes that sharpen unclear requirements, push back when a profile isn't hireable, calibrate on candidates, and hold the process to a standard when timelines get tight. Develop sourcing strategies for talent that rarely applies passive outreach, Boolean, referrals, networking, and competitive intelligence across travel tech, marketplaces, and B2B SaaS. Maintain pipelines for critical and recurring roles, so we're not starting from zero each time a req opens. Coach hiring managers on interviewing and keep our assessment consistent as teams grow. Use hiring data, funnel conversion, time-to-hire, and source effectiveness to change how we hire, not just to report on it. Keep the ATS accurate and support employer branding in the communities we hire from. Strong Product hiring track record. You can hold a credible conversation about discovery, roadmaps, and metrics, and judge whether a candidate's story about impact holds up. Breadth across Tech and Business hiring alongside that depth. Strong stakeholder management with senior hiring managers. You can redirect a stalled search, challenge a hiring manager, and deliver difficult market news without damaging the relationship. A proven pipeline of both active and passive candidates, with rapport built throughout and offers closed at the end. Data fluency: you can build a funnel view and use it to make an argument. You have a curious mindset, always testing and adapting your search approach, driven by finding the right talent — and open to 360-degree feedback as a way to keep growing. Comfortable in a fast-moving, global, diverse start-up environment, and open to feedback. You have a curious mindset and an interest in research; open to 360-degree feedback and looking to grow. Tools affinity, keeping our ATS updated, and data accurate. You are fluent in English, both verbal and written. What you can expect: Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide. Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions. Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions. Work with industry leaders. Our partners include , Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF. Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day. Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow. Our hiring process for this role: Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Nayab Fatima, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Masha Marynova . items.summary: StellarTech is a rapidly growing product company building scalable EdTech products for a global audience.
items.description: StellarTech is a rapidly growing product company building scalable EdTech products for a global audience. As our business and product portfolio continue to grow, we are strengthening our Talent Acquisition team and looking for a Senior Recruiter to own complex, business-critical hiring across the company. This is a full-cycle role with a strong focus on direct search, hiring manager partnership, and measurable outcomes. You will lead 4-6 roles at a time - including Senior, Lead, and Head-level positions - and help us build the systems that make every next hire more focused, predictable, and effective. What You’ll Do Own 4-6 vacancies end to end, with a focus on senior, leadership, and business-critical roles. Partner with hiring managers from the kick-off stage: clarify the business need, shape a realistic candidate profile, define the scorecard, and align on the hiring process. Build a sourcing strategy for each role, including talent-market mapping, donor-company research, Boolean and X-ray search, LinkedIn sourcing, and personalized outreach sequences. Proactively engage passive candidates instead of relying mainly on inbound applications. Conduct structured interviews, assess candidates against agreed criteria, and provide clear, evidence-based recommendations. Prepare and calibrate hiring managers and interviewers to ensure consistent, high-quality assessment across all stages. Own the recruitment funnel and use data to identify bottlenecks, improve stage conversions, and keep stakeholders aligned on progress and risks. Manage the offer process and candidate communication through to the person’s first working day. Bring market intelligence to the business: talent availability, compensation expectations, competitor insights, and realistic hiring timelines. What We’re Looking For 6+ years of experience in full-cycle recruitment, including at least 4 years in a product IT company. Experience hiring for Growth Marketing, Product, Analytics, or Engineering roles. Experience in B2C subscription products, mobile apps, EdTech, or another high-growth digital environment. A proven track record of closing Senior, Lead, or Head-level roles, with the ability to explain your approach, funnel metrics, timelines, and results. Strong hands-on sourcing expertise and confidence working with passive talent across multiple channels. Experience partnering with hiring managers, challenging unclear or unrealistic requirements, and translating business needs into an actionable search strategy. A structured, data-informed approach to recruitment: you understand funnel metrics, conversion rates, and how to use them to improve outcomes. Experience with competency-based assessment, scorecards, and structured interviews. Strong ownership and communication skills, with the ability to manage several priorities and keep stakeholders aligned. Practical use of AI tools in day-to-day recruiting - for research, sourcing, communication, analysis, or workflow automation. Fluency in Ukrainian with English at B2 level or above. Why You’ll Love Working With Us High-impact hiring: You’ll own roles that directly affect product delivery, team capability, and business growth. Room to shape the function: Our Talent Acquisition system is evolving, and you’ll have a real voice in how we build processes, tools, and standards. Direct partnership: You’ll work closely with hiring managers and business leaders, with clear access to decision-makers. AI-enabled workflow: We provide access to AI subscriptions and modern recruiting tools to automate routine work and focus on higher-value decisions. Health support: We offer medical expense compensation. Work-life balance: You’ll have flexible paid time off, including 21 days of annual leave plus 10 bank holidays. Collaborative culture: You’ll work with curious, driven people who value ownership, clarity, and evidence-based decisions. Hiring Process Introductory call with the Head of People - 30 minutes. Functional interview - 60 minutes. Live recruitment case - 60 minutes, with no take-home assignment. Final meeting - 30 minutes. If you enjoy solving complex hiring challenges, working closely with the business, and building systems rather than simply following them, we’d love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: your mission Over the years, partnerships have been one of the most powerful and capital-efficient channels for our business.
items.description: your mission Over the years, partnerships have been one of the most powerful and capital-efficient channels for our business. From a historical base of 192 interested leads generated through partner introductions and referrals — resulting in 19 past customers and 4 active customers, including a publicly traded company acquired through our Remote.com partnership — we know this motion works. As Partnerships Manager, You will own and scale this engine. This is a builder role: starting from a strong foundation of informal relationships and past wins, you will formalize and grow two distinct partnership pipelines — Commercial and Marketing — that together drive revenue, brand visibility, and long-term strategic positioning. Business Context & Partnership Model Our partnerships have historically operated across two value streams: Commercial Partnerships — Revenue & Lead Generation The commercial partnerships model is straightforward: we work with organisations whose clients or members are likely to need our services, and we structure introductions, referrals (paid and unpaid), and co-selling arrangements. Partners act as a trusted channel into qualified networks — shortening our sales cycle and increasing close rates because leads arrive with built-in credibility. items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium URL: https://www.twikey.com Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you. Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly. Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product. As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product. You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions. With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed! A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose. The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast! A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-java-developer

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Palo Alto, CA, US; Remote, US About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here . This role focuses on advancing the science and systems behind ML measurement, feature understanding, and causal inference at scale. The work spans areas such as production feature importance platforms, observational causal estimation in Pytorch, large-scale proxy metric development, and data-driven approaches to ML infrastructure efficiency. We're looking for an enthusiastic individual contributor to perform high-impact technical work across this space. This person will drive foundational innovations, own the end-to-end design of production ML systems, establish rigorous methodological standards, and partner cross-functionally to turn successful research into durable platform capabilities that raise the ceiling for the entire ML organization. What you’ll do: We are looking for an experienced and highly capable Data & Applied Scientist to help us drive step function improvements in our ML capabilities at Pinterest. In this role, you will: Translate research-grade DS workflows (e.g., proxy metrics, staleness models) into production ML pipelines using Airflow, WandB & Ray while establishing reusable patterns for other teams. Apply and productionize causal inference methods using the production ML stack (propensity scoring, IPW, TMLE) to address high-stakes measurement questions beyond experimental capabilities. Build self-serve tooling to empower non-experts to derive rigorous causal insights at scale. Partner with ML engineers and product teams to identify opportunities for improved tooling, metrics, and measurement methods, unlocking step-change improvements in model quality and business outcomes. Leverage Pinterest's rich metadata and engagement signals to build data-driven frameworks, from feature importance to content deindexing, that improve platform efficiency and speed. Design and build centralized ML platform tooling to improve feature and model creation, evaluation, and trust, including production systems that operate daily at scale across all models. What we’re looking for: 2+ years of hands-on experience as an applied scientist, ML engineer, research scientist or software engineer, with significant ML production experience. Strong Python skills; experience with PyTorch or equivalent deep learning frameworks; familiarity with distributed compute (Spark, Ray). Ray specifically is a strong plus. Enthusiasm for building tools and platforms that multiply the impact of an entire ML organization; not just solving one-off problems. Deep ML theory knowledge with extremely strong fundamentals that can help us reason about ML models from first principles. Proficiency in software development best practices including version control, code review, and reproducible ML pipelines. Experience with workflow management tools (Airflow, Prefect, Jenkins, or similar) for reliable ML pipeline orchestration. Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience. Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. In-Office Requirement Statement: We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Canada URL: https://designfiles.co/ About the job: We're looking for a highly organized Content Marketing Coordinator to join our team on a remote contract basis. This role is ideal for someone who loves turning ideas into finished marketing campaigns. You'll write content, coordinate creative assets, keep projects moving, and make sure every email, social post, landing page, and product announcement is polished before it reaches our audience. We're not looking for flashy marketing copy. We're looking for someone who can communicate like a real human, who can write the way you'd talk to a designer over coffee: helpful, clear, and genuinely useful. If you're someone who notices the small details, enjoys keeping projects organized, and gets satisfaction from shipping great work, we'd love to hear from you. What you’ll help with: You'll work closely with our marketing and product teams to help bring campaigns to life by: Writing and editing marketing emails, newsletters, social posts, ads, landing pages, product updates, and promotional copy Turning campaign ideas, product launches, and feature updates into clear action plans, timelines, and deliverables Coordinating with designers to create graphics, creative assets, and revisions Gathering screenshots, product details, customer examples, links, and supporting materials needed for marketing projects Scheduling and publishing emails, social content, and other marketing updates Helping execute product launches, webinars, contests, promotions, and campaigns Reviewing marketing assets before they go live to ensure quality and accuracy Keeping marketing calendars, task lists, and project documentation organized and up to date Following up with team members to keep projects moving and deadlines on track What you’ll need: Excellent writing and editing skills Able to write marketing that feels like a helpful one-on-one conversation, not generic sales copy Strong understanding of audience, tone, and clear communication Exceptional organization and attention to detail (this is one of the most important parts of the role) Comfortable managing multiple projects at once without losing track of details Reliable follow-through and a bias toward getting things done Experience with email marketing, social media, content marketing, or campaign execution Bonus points: Experience working with SaaS companies Experience in the interior design industry or another creative field About us: DesignFiles is an all-in-one business platform built specifically for interior designers. Thousands of designers use DesignFiles to manage projects, collaborate with clients, create presentations, source products, and run more profitable businesses. Everything we create is designed to make designers' lives easier, and our marketing reflects that. We focus on education, practical advice, and helping designers succeed—not pushy sales tactics. Apply for the job: Love writing clear, helpful content and keeping marketing projects moving? Join DesignFiles as a remote Content Marketing Coordinator. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/designfiles-content-marketing-coordinator

Our Real World Evidence team is hiring a Senior Research Scientist to join our team of research professionals conducting real
items.description: Senior Research Scientist - RWE Are you looking to work with a dynamic team of industry leading professionals in the HEOR space? Is your passion leading Real World Evidence studies that improve healthcare outcomes worldwide? Our Real World Evidence team is hiring a Senior Research Scientist to join our team of research professionals conducting real-world studies in the pharmacy and biotech space; operating as a thought leader, problem solver and data expert. This is a fully remote position. About You: You are an experienced health economics and outcomes research consultant with an understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and medical affairs and can anticipate client needs. You have expertise in the conduct of real-world studies, including data feasibility assessments, developing study protocols, analytic dataset creation, data analyses, and study reports. You can perform analyses independently and are comfortable making recommendations to the client and team members on study direction. You can anticipate and identify considerations relevant to the implementation of various approaches, including potential facilitators of and barriers to successful project and task execution. You are comfortable presenting to and interacting with clients across functions. About The Role: As a Senior Research Scientist on the RWE team at Precision AQ, you will contribute to multiple projects comprised of cross-functional staff, serving as the analytics expert on the project. You will design RWE studies, develop protocols and analysis plans, perform analyses of primary and secondary data, and communicate study results internally and externally. Required Experience: 4-6+ years of experience in RWE Master’s degree in a subject related to health services research e.g., health economics, public policy, health policy, epidemiology, biostatistics, or public health Proficiency in SAS or R Ability to work effectively individually and as part of a diverse team Awareness and understanding of financial performance on projects Helpful Experience: PhD in a subject related to health services research e.g., health economics, public policy, health policy, epidemiology, biostatistics, or public health Willingness and desire to learn and share knowledge Excellent oral and written communication skills #LI-Remote Precision is required by law in some states or cities to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. items.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Instacart+ at Instacart
items.summary: We’re transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our communi
items.description: We’re transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. Instacart is a Flex First team There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Why this role is on the menu Instacart+ is Instacart’s membership program, the connective tissue between the brand and its most loyal, high-value customers. With benefits like $0 delivery fees, partner perks, and exclusive savings, Instacart+ is the foundation of our long-term customer relationship strategy. Members shop more, spend more, and stay longer, and this role is responsible for making sure more customers become Instacart+ members and realize the benefits of doing so. We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the full go-to-market strategy for Instacart+. You’ll shape how we position, message, and grow the membership program from acquisition campaigns that convert first-timers to lifecycle strategies that deepen engagement with existing members. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role at the intersection of product, brand, and growth. The ideal candidate has deep roots in subscription or loyalty marketing, having grown a membership program, driven retention through value communication, and knows how to make the math of membership feel like a no-brainer to a consumer. You bring both the analytical rigor to understand what’s working and the storytelling instinct to make it resonate. This role reports to the Director, Consumer Product Marketing. What you’ll cook up in your first year Own the Instacart+ differentiated positioning that sets it apart from competing membership and subscription offerings. Members have a reason to stay: you’ve identified the moments where member value is highest and built messaging and lifecycle programs that bring those moments to life across email, push, in-app, and paid. Acquisition is measurably stronger: you’ve partnered with growth and performance marketing teams to develop and test messaging frameworks that convert trial users and lapsed members into committed subscribers. The product roadmap reflects member insights: you’ve become the internal voice of the Instacart+ member, bringing qualitative and quantitative research into roadmap conversations that shape what gets built next. New Instacart+ features launch with best-in-class GTM plans: you own the brief, the messaging, and the channel strategy from kickoff through post-launch performance review. Senior stakeholders and XFN partners trust you as the category expert: you’ve developed a compelling POV on the subscription and loyalty landscape and use it to sharpen the Instacart+ strategy. The secret ingredients we’re looking for Must-have pantry staples Minimum Qualifications 8+ years of progressive experience in marketing, with at least 4+ years in product marketing; experience at a consumer tech company is strongly preferred. Demonstrated track record owning GTM strategy for a subscription, membership, or loyalty program, from positioning through lifecycle, with measurable results. Deep fluency in subscription/loyalty marketing mechanics: you understand member acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and churn, and know how to use marketing to move each lever. A sharp strategic mind that can synthesize consumer research, behavioral data, and competitive signals into positioning and messaging that cuts through Proven ability to influence product roadmaps. You’ve brought the voice of the customer into planning cycles and shaped what gets built, not just how it gets marketed. Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting and defending strategy to VP and C-suite stakeholders. Experience partnering closely with growth, lifecycle/CRM, creative, and data science teams to develop and execute multi-channel campaigns Proficient in using data and A/B testing to develop and iterate on messaging; as comfortable in a metrics dashboard as in a creative brief Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience Optional garnishes Preferred Qualifications Experience marketing a subscription or loyalty program in a marketplace or two-sided platform context (e.g., retail, food delivery, grocery) Background working on programs with tiered benefits, earn/burn mechanics, or partner integrations Experience running or partnering on member research, including surveys, focus groups, UXR to surface insights that directly inform strategy Prior experience managing or mentoring PMMs or junior marketers Familiarity with the grocery or CPG retail marketing landscape #LI-Remote Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia. Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here. For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below. CAN $153,000—$161,500 CAD

At Legion, we are seeking a Director of Engineering, DevOps & SRE to lead the teams responsible
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote, United States Director of Production Engineering Remote, United States About this Position Are you passionate about building the reliability, automation, and security foundations that let engineering teams move fast with confidence? At Legion, we are seeking a Director of Engineering, DevOps & SRE to lead the teams responsible for the availability, scalability, and security of our production environment. Our production infrastructure runs on AWS, leveraging services such as EKS, RDS, and a broad set of AWS-native technologies. You will partner closely with engineering and IT to build resilient systems, drive operational excellence, and ensure our platform meets the highest standards of security and compliance. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll spend ~20-30% of your time contributing directly to architecture, tooling, and incident response, and the rest driving vision, roadmap, and cross-team execution. Responsibilities Hire and build a globally-distributed DevOps/SRE engineering team. Recruit, mentor, and manage engineers, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Own the reliability and infrastructure roadmap for our AWS-based production environment, including EKS, RDS, and related AWS services, ensuring scalability, high availability, and cost efficiency. Lead the organization's security operations (SecOps) practice, including vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, and remediation, to proactively identify and resolve security issues before they impact customers. Define and drive engineering OKRs for infrastructure reliability, automation, and security, and track progress against measurable outcomes. Champion observability and alerting best practices (e.g., Datadog), including automating alert triage and response to reduce mean-time-to-resolution. Solid understanding of agentic AI infrastructure and how AI agentic workflows apply to SDLC and DevOps processes (e.g., automated investigation, remediation, and PR-generation pipelines). Drive Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, and automation practices to increase engineering velocity and reduce operational toil. Work closely with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure standards, access controls, tooling, and compliance requirements across the organization. Ensure the platform meets the highest standards of security, compliance, and data protection; implement and maintain robust security controls and audit-readiness. Lead and participate in the Incident Management on-call rotation, working with SRE and development teams to meet and exceed availability goals. Stay current on cloud, DevOps, and security best practices, and provide technical guidance and thought leadership to the broader engineering organization. Gerenciar e priorizar demandas, incidentes e problemas críticos, assegurando tratamento adequado dentro dos SLAs definidos. Conduzir análises de causa raiz e coordenar planos de ação para mitigação de recorrências. Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre as áreas de negócio e as equipes de TI para temas relacionados à sustentação. Avaliar impactos de mudanças sistêmicas nos processos financeiros e operacionais. Realizar acompanhamento contínuo da saúde dos sistemas, identificando riscos e oportunidades de melhoria. Gestão de Relacionamento com o Negócio Manter relacionamento próximo e constante com as áreas de Finanças. Conduzir reuniões recorrentes de alinhamento, priorização e acompanhamento das demandas. Levantar requisitos, mapear processos e traduzir necessidades de negócio para equipes técnicas. Garantir comunicação clara e permanente entre stakeholders, usuários-chave e times de tecnologia. Gestão de Projetos Liderar projetos de evolução sistêmica, automação e transformação digital para as áreas financeiras. Coordenar atividades desde a definição do escopo até implantação em produção. Elaborar cronogramas, planos de ação, análise de riscos e acompanhamento de entregas. Conduzir cerimônias de projeto e reuniões executivas de status. Apoiar processos de testes, homologação, treinamento e gestão da mudança. Gestão de Backlog e Priorização Manter backlog de melhorias e demandas atualizado e priorizado. Definir critérios de priorização considerando impacto financeiro, riscos regulatórios, experiência do usuário e valor para o negócio. Trabalhar junto às equipes de desenvolvimento para refinamento de requisitos e acompanhamento das entregas. Qualifications Conhecimento dos principais processos financeiros, incluindo: Contratação e Faturamento (Billing) Contas a Receber (Accounts Receivable) Revenue Recognition Cobrança e aplicações de recebimentos Controles financeiros e contábeis Inglês avançado obrigatório Sistemas e Ferramentas Gestão de backlog (Jira, Azure DevOps ou similares) Ferramentas de documentação (Confluence ou similares) Power BI e IA (desejável) Experiência com ERP, sistemas financeiros e integrações Metodologias Agile / Scrum Kanban Gestão de Projetos Competências Comportamentais Comunicação clara e objetiva Forte capacidade de priorização Senso de urgência Organização e gestão simultânea de múltiplas demandas Perfil colaborativo e orientado ao cliente interno Capacidade de negociação com stakeholders Visão de processos e resolução de problemas Facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com constante mudança de prioridades Diferenciais Experiência prévia em áreas de Finance Systems, Finance Transformation ou Product Ownership em Finanças. Conhecimento de processos O2C, P2P e R2R. Experiência em sustentação de aplicações corporativas críticas. Participação em projetos de implementação ou transformação de sistemas financeiros. Additional Information Esta é uma posição exclusiva para pessoas com deficiência (PcD). Como parte do nosso compromisso com a inclusão e a igualdade de oportunidades, aqui na Serasa temos diversas iniciativas, como por exemplo: intérpretes de libras, tecnologias assistivas, cordão girassol (deficiências ocultas), entre outras ações. Na Serasa Experian temos o grupo Aspire que visa construir para um ambiente acessível e de oportunidades justas para os profissionais com deficiência. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação! Caso você não se identifique com este grupo, convidamos você a explorar outras oportunidades em nossa página de carreiras. Temos diversas vagas que podem se conectar com seu perfil e interesses. #LI-HOME Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together Find out what its like to work for Experian by clicking here

items.title: Conceptual Art Director
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Conceptual Art Director with a passion for Generative AI to create bold, high-performing digital campaigns for top global brands. In this role, you’ll partner with copywriters, strategists and creatives to deliver concept-driven ideas across social media, web, video, and more—bringing big ideas to life with strong art direction and design execution. You’ll thrive in a collaborative, globally distributed team and contribute to work that’s not only creatively exciting but also strategically sharp. This is a role for someone who can think big, execute beautifully, and bring a deep understanding of design to everything they do.

items.title: Conceptual Copywriter
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Conceptual Copywriter to ideate and execute impactful creative work across digital campaigns and marketing channels. In this role, you’ll partner with designers, strategists, and performance teams to develop concept-driven copy that delivers both creative impact and measurable results. You will work closely with enterprise-level customers helping translate complex technical ideas into clear, compelling messaging for global audiences. This role is ideal for a writer who enjoys turning strategic insights into powerful creative ideas while crafting high-performing copy across digital platforms.

items.title: Lead Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing)
items.summary: Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll sit at the intersection of data and creative, turning performance signals from paid social, OOH, and programmatic campaigns into sharp, testable creative direction — while acting as a trusted strategic partner to the clients whose business results depend on it. You'll run strategy across a portfolio of accounts at once, each producing a high volume of creative every month, and you'll be the person both the client and the creative team turn to when they need to know not just what to make next, but why.

items.title: Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst
items.summary: Position Type : Full-time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST About the Company Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Responsibilities Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces. Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers. items.summary: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.About 1PasswordAt 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future.
