items.description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. We’re looking for a Digital Customer Success Campaign Manager to design, launch, and improve digital customer journeys at scale. You’ll turn customer and product signals into timely, useful programs that help customers move from trial through activation, adoption, and ongoing value. This is a hands-on, program-focused role for someone who enjoys combining thoughtful communication, data, experimentation, and emerging technology. Reporting into the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success, this role is based remotely in North America, with hiring locations in the United States or Canada. How we’re using AI today Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here. What we're looking for: • Bring experience in Digital Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Growth Operations, Customer Success Operations, or Product-led Growth within a Software as a Service (SaaS) environment. • Have owned or significantly contributed to lifecycle or digital customer programs with measurable impact. • Write clear, engaging customer-facing communications and adapt messaging for different audiences and customer needs. • Interpret customer and product usage data, identify patterns, and turn insights into practical campaign and journey improvements. • Work effectively across Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Data, Operations, and Content teams while navigating changing priorities and building new programs from the ground up. Bonus points for: • Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) tools to accelerate campaign development, analysis, experimentation, or content creation. • Experience with 1Password, cybersecurity, or a similar technology product. What you can expect: • Design, launch, and continuously improve digital customer journeys across onboarding, activation, adoption, expansion, and renewal. • Develop targeted campaigns that help customers move from trial to meaningful product adoption and guide them toward the right next step. • Draft, edit, and optimize customer-facing email campaigns, connecting them with education resources and other digital experiences. • Use customer signals, milestones, and behaviors to identify moments of friction or opportunity and create timely interventions. • Monitor campaign performance through metrics such as engagement, activation, product usage, retention, and expansion; use experimentation and cohort analysis to improve results. • Partner with Data and Analytics teams to support dashboards and reporting, then use those insights to make informed recommendations. • Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Content partners to keep programs accurate, useful, and aligned with the customer journey. • Use tools such as Gainsight, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, and AI solutions to increase campaign quality, testing speed, and operational efficiency. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building in an evolving environment, can work independently through ambiguity, and is motivated by creating scalable customer experiences that help more people get value from 1Password. USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $96,000 USD and $134,000 USD. This role is also immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $88,000 CAD and $123,000 CAD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. How we work with AI We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password. This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. Our approach to work We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement. For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average. Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. What we offer We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: Health and wellbeing Maternity and parental leave top-up programs Competitive health benefits Generous PTO policy Growth and future RSU program for most employees Retirement matching program Free 1Password account Community Paid volunteer days Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly Remote-first work environment *Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting. You belong here. 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs. Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you. Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law. 1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See here for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing this form . For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice .

items.title: Business Operations Manager
items.summary: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
items.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on. About the Role The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations Manager to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes. The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems. Core Responsibilities 1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented. 2. Project Management & Visibility Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s. 3. Product Rollout Support Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model. 4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned. 5. Data & Spreadsheet Management Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental. Who You Are The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC). The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably. Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process. Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly. What We Offer True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle. Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior PPC Specialist
items.summary: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms.
items.description: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that successful paid media isn't just about launching campaigns; it's about maximizing profitability. You'll be responsible for optimizing the entire acquisition funnel, analyzing campaign performance, improving conversion rates, and making strategic decisions that drive sustainable growth. The ideal candidate is analytical, data-driven, and comfortable balancing campaign execution with performance strategy. Requirements Key Responsibilities Plan, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other advertising platforms. Monitor and improve key performance metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, Conversion Rate, and LTV. Identify profitability issues and optimize the entire conversion funnel. Conduct A/B testing for audiences, creatives, landing pages, and offers. Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights through dashboards and reports. Manage advertising budgets and scale high-performing campaigns. Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to improve campaign results. Implement and maintain tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advertising platforms. Stay up to date with industry trends, AI tools, and platform updates. Requirements Resume in English. Native or near-native English proficiency (spoken and written). 4+ years of experience managing Meta and Google Ads campaigns. Proven experience optimizing campaigns based on ROAS, CPA, CAC, and profitability. Strong understanding of conversion funnels and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and reporting dashboards. Experience managing six-figure monthly advertising budgets is a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with eCommerce, SaaS, Lead Generation, or Performance Marketing campaigns. Ability to translate data into actionable optimization strategies. By applying to this position, we'll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match. items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! Originally posted on Himalayas

Job Description: This job is responsible for capturing and refining business or system requirements that may involve a software change. Key responsibilities include working with stakeholders to understand their needs, analyzing problems, capturing requirements, creating solutions, solving problems either manually or through software, and providing subject-matter expertise on products to support scope and requirement decisions. Job expectations include collaborating with project stakeholders to analyze and confirm requirements, creating, analyzing, and improving processes and writing user and technical stories. This job is responsible for supporting centralized intake management, demand forecasting, resource management, and executive communications activities for a Data Management organization within Global Technology. Key responsibilities include managing engagement intake processes, assessing demand, forecasting resource and funding requirements, monitoring portfolio performance, and developing executive reporting and governance materials that support strategic decision-making. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ SimpleTiger is seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior PPC Manager to lead paid media strategy and execution for our B2B SaaS clients. This role is ideal for a seasoned performance marketer with 5+ years of hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing multi-channel paid advertising campaigns. The Senior PPC Manager will own campaign performance across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram; translate client growth objectives into effective paid media strategies; and deliver clear, proactive communication and recommendations. You will work closely with our SEO, content, design, sales, and product teams to maximize qualified pipeline, customer acquisition, and return on ad spend for a portfolio of SaaS clients. Key Responsibilities Develop and lead comprehensive paid media strategies tailored to each client’s growth stage, business model, target audience, sales cycle, and revenue goals. Independently build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram. Own campaign setup from end to end, including keyword research, audience strategy, account and campaign structure, ad group development, bid strategies, conversion tracking, budget allocation, and ad creative direction. Monitor and optimize campaigns against core performance metrics, including CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, pipeline contribution, ROAS, and ROI. Develop and manage testing roadmaps for ad copy, creative, landing pages, offers, audiences, bidding strategies, and campaign structures. Analyze performance data to identify trends, diagnose issues, uncover growth opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations. Partner with content and design teams to develop high-performing ad creative and messaging that resonates with B2B SaaS buyers. Collaborate with the SEO team to ensure PPC strategies complement broader organic search, content, and demand-generation initiatives. Manage paid media budgets responsibly, making informed recommendations on spend allocation, scaling opportunities, and efficiency improvements. Work directly with clients to communicate performance, explain strategy, set expectations, and provide timely, proactive updates and recommendations. Lead client-facing reporting and performance discussions, turning complex campaign data into clear business insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Partner with sales and product stakeholders to align campaign targeting, messaging, and conversion goals with customer insights and business priorities. Build and maintain strong relationships with platform representatives to access platform support, strategic guidance, beta opportunities, and new features. Stay current on paid media platform updates, privacy and tracking changes, B2B SaaS advertising trends, and emerging best practices. Contribute to the continued improvement of SimpleTiger’s PPC processes, reporting frameworks, account standards, and strategic playbooks. Provide mentorship, strategic guidance, and quality assurance support to junior team members as the PPC function grows. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing PPC and paid social campaigns, ideally in B2B SaaS, an agency, or a high-growth technology environment. Proven experience managing substantial budgets across Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, with required experience in Meta Ads Manager (Facebook and Instagram). Deep expertise in Google Ads, including Search, Display, YouTube, remarketing, Performance Max, conversion tracking, and automated bidding strategies. Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn and Meta advertising, including audience development, retargeting, lead-generation campaigns, and full-funnel B2B campaign strategy. Demonstrated success improving paid-media performance through structured testing, strategic budget allocation, ongoing optimization, and rigorous performance analysis. Experience launching campaigns from scratch and owning paid-media accounts from audit and strategy through execution, reporting, and continuous optimization. Proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and comparable analytics, attribution, and reporting tools. Experience using AI-enabled tools and advertising-platform automation to improve campaign analysis, creative development, workflow efficiency, and optimization—while applying sound judgment to validate outputs and recommendations. Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms, preferably HubSpot, and with B2B SaaS funnel metrics including lead quality, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, CAC, LTV, and revenue attribution. Strong analytical, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders. Highly organized, self-directed, and detail-oriented, with the judgment and accountability to manage multiple client accounts in a remote, results-driven environment. Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications preferred, but not required. Compensation & Benefits 100% remote work environment Results-oriented work environment Flexible working hours and vacation policy Company-provided computer for all team members All typical U.S. holidays observed with full paid time off Health insurance through the JustWorks HR platform 401(k) through Vestwell To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-b2b-saas-ppc-manager

items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: United Kingdom (Remote) Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue. We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us. Senior SRE - Networks Fastly’s Technical Operations (TechOps) team is responsible for building & operating the infrastructure that powers the Fastly Edge Cloud Platform. We oversee an extensive global network that spans 6 continents with over 100 points of presence and 578 Tbps of connected capacity. Our platform serves a significant portion of the content delivered to internet consumers across the planet, with customers ranging from online media streaming services to e-commerce, to open source projects, nonprofits and more. We take this responsibility seriously! We’re looking for an experienced SRE with strong focus on Networks, SRE principals and knowledge of the internet who can bring engineering best practices, operational rigour, and automation skills to help craft the future of Fastly’s network and directly contribute to making the internet better. What You'll Do: Build, operate, and maintain the continually growing global network footprint of Fastly’s Edge Cloud Platform. Response to significant traffic incidents and lead network incidents, resolving edge cases and failure scenarios with your expertise in IP routing, particularly BGP. Write code that is performant, maintainable, clear, and concise and contribute to code reviews, improving the codebase and other team processes Partner in the development and iteration of tools and automation systems that improve how we operate and build the network. Innovate new methods for monitoring network performance, focusing on the end-user experience, and proactively address potential issues. Continual deep-dive of performance-based analytics and close involvement with partner teams to maintain a performant global network. Advocate for the operational stability of the network by identifying opportunities and partnering with engineering teams to shape their roadmaps and software solutions. Mentor team members on the complexities of global routing, especially in an anycast-heavy environment. What We're Looking For: Experience in the protocols and practices that make up the fabric of the global internet, including TCP/IP, BGP, Anycast and DNS. Experience in Automation and coding using languages like Python, or similar. Proficiency in Tier 1 Internet service providers, Internet exchanges and cloud providers. Ability to analyze internet traffic patterns across multiple dimensions using flow-based tools. Experience working with alerting, monitoring and visibility tools (such as Graphite/Grafana, Prometheus, or Splunk). Knowledge across cloud hosting solutions (i.e., GCP, AWS and Azure). Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI / CD pipelines (ie. Git, Jenkins, Ansible). Understanding of Linux/Unix systems administration and network stack optimisation. Adept at knowledge sharing and creating comprehensive documentation to empower teams. Able to collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape the technical roadmap, prioritizing initiatives to optimize automation tooling and the network. We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these: Experience writing production-level code using VCL or GO Experience in network telemetry including instrumenting infrastructure and collecting, processing, storing and analyzing data Experience working with geographically dispersed teams: previous remote work preferred Work Hours: This position will require you to work during scheduled hours from 0800 - 1700. This position will require you to be available during core business hours. It may also require occasional nights and weekends as necessary to support any on-call coverage. Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements : Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home. This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager. This position has one opening and can be hired in the following locations: London (Hybrid) UK, Remote Benefits: We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings? We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet your needs. Our offerings may vary depending on the country where you work and are subject to change. Why Fastly? We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives . Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand. We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful -- every day. We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about. We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply! A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying. All job applications must be submitted through our official careers site at www.fastly.com/about/careers . We will never request sensitive information, such as your Social Security number, bank account or credit card information during the application process. All official communication will come from an @ fastly.com or @ recruiting.fastly.com email address. Fastly is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity and to providing employees with a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Our employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, family or parental status, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and federal or state disability laws, Fastly will provide reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact your Recruiter, or the Fastly Employee Relations team at candidateaccommodations@fastly.com or 501-287-4901. Fastly collects and processes personal data submitted by job applicants in accordance with our Privacy Policy . Please see our privacy notice for job applicants . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fastly-senior-sre-networks

items.description: Who we are We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence. We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way. Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit. Why Worldwide We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us! What the Senior Statistician does at Worldwide Independently manages statistical project support and provides expert statistical consultancy across the stats function. What you will do Manage the statistics support to one or more projects/sponsor programs of work, ensuring that needs are met by expert and timely statistical consultancy and support Provides expert review of study designs, analysis plans, and reports Assist sponsors in the design of clinical trials, including statistical sections of the study protocol, randomization methodology, and writing statistical analysis plans Consult with internal departments, sponsors, and other third parties regarding statistical issues and reporting requirements Provide project support to the statistics reporting process through the specification/review of tables, figures, and listings shells, writing/review of derived dataset specifications, and the formatting of report documents and tabulations Undertake the preparation of final reports, including the production of tables, listings, and figures, and report writing Develop, evaluate, and run Statistical Analysis System (SAS) programs for the statistical analysis and reporting of clinical study data. This includes programs for derived datasets, Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC), Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM), and Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets, tables, figures, and listings, and their validation Ensure the maintenance of documentation, e.g., the description of programs and validation Produce ad hoc data summaries when requested during a trial. Extract information from the system during a trial, e.g., summaries, data listings, study data sets. Validate software, in the role of system owner or tester, and test SAS Macros, maintaining the required validation and testing documentation Make statistical contributions to manuscripts for publication/presentation Provide support for the bidding process, including contribution to budget review, proposals, and bid defense meetings Lead the identification of system and process improvements, and develop and implement solutions to improve the efficiency and quality of clinical study data processing and reporting Support the development of statistical design and analysis policies Maintain knowledge in design consultancy and analysis methodology, statistical software packages (e.g., SAS and nQuery), and regulatory guidance documents, e.g. International Council for Harmonization (ICH), Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and Committee for Medicinal Products (CPMP) points to consider Assist with Quality Assurance and Audit requirements Assist the Director of Biostatistics with all other aspects of the job as required Perform all activities in compliance with Worldwide Clinical Trials and agreed sponsor quality system standards, relevant ICH standards, and specifically with FDA Quality System Regulation (including 21CFR Part 11) Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. What you bring to the role: Computer literate and numerate with a proven ability to adapt to various computer systems Expert-level project statistician experienced in providing statistical leadership to projects Design and analysis consultancy skills and knowledge across a broad range of applications, together with key competencies in customer focus, delivering on commitments, building strong relationships, communicating, influencing, and embracing innovation and change Your experience Master's level in mathematics, statistics, or another subject required with a strong statistical component Minimum 3 years of statistical experience leading clinical trial projects and data analysis At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace by providing transparent compensation. The salary range for this position is annually (For hourly paid positions, the stated salary range reflects hourly rates): United States of America - $87,500.00 - $173,500.00 The salary range provided is intended to give candidates an understanding of potential earnings. Compensation will fall within the provided range, and it not a guarantee of exact salary. The final salary will be determined based on relevant experience, performance, education, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive benefits package depending on location. We ensure pay equity and transparency and comply with all applicable labor laws. Salary information will be discussed during the interview process, and we encourage candidates to inquire about compensation at any stage. We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do. To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide ! For more information on Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn .

items.title: Director of International Business Development & Sales
items.summary: Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery.
items.description: Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery. We deliver high-resolution thermal insights that help governments, defense agencies, and agribusinesses better manage water resources, agricultural production, national security threats, and critical infrastructure. We grow through two distinct routes to market – government programmes, and commercial data and subscription products – and our product and engineering teams build the platform that powers both. Hydrosat is hiring a Director of International BD & Sales to bost growth, identify and develop strategic opportunities, and strengthen our position across international government markets. This is a senior, hands-on role combining channel leadership, business development, and market intelligence. You will own Hydrosat ’s international partner ecosystem, shape market-entry strategies, and identify relevant government programs before they reach formal procurement. Working closely with the VP Global, Government Programs, you will represent Hydrosat with senior customers and partners, make recommendations on where the company should invest its resources, and coordinate early-stage opportunities into qualified captures. Responsibilities Channel Strategy and Management Audit, improve and execute Hydrosat ’s international channel strategy. Identify, recruit, negotiate with, and onboard resellers and strategic partners. Establish reseller agreements for satellite data, IrriWatch, and other relevant Hydrosat solutions. Manage partner pipelines and hold resellers accountable against clear activity, pipeline, and revenue targets. Provide partners with the use cases, marketing materials, pricing guidance, training, and commercial support needed to generate and maximize revenue. Structure the global reseller network through partner tiers and performance reviews Grow partner-generated pipeline and revenue while addressing underperforming relationships. International Strategy and Market Development Develop market-entry strategies for priority countries and regions. Map government landscapes, including end users, buyers, budget owners, procurement processes, funding sources, and existing capabilities. Identify and engage relevant local partners, institutional stakeholders, and decision-makers. Produce actionable country and market strategies for leadership decision-making. Represent Hydrosat in selected customer, partner, and institutional engagements. Opportunity Intelligence and Early Capture Establish a systematic approach to monitoring relevant RFIs, tenders, funding programs, and institutional initiatives worldwide. Track national and international procurement platforms. Qualify opportunities based on strategic fit, funding, customer access, competitive position, timing, and probability of success. Develop preliminary capture strategies and make clear go/no-go recommendations. Position Hydrosat with key stakeholders before formal procurements are released. Advance qualified opportunities into structured captures Contribute to the development and adoption of Hydrosat ’s value proposition across government markets. Maintain accurate partner, market, and opportunity intelligence in CRM. Requirements At least eight years of experience in international business development, partnerships, channel management, market strategy, or capture. Demonstrated success building commercial partnerships and developing complex government or institutional opportunities. Strong commercial judgment and the ability to operate independently across multiple markets. Confidence engaging senior government, institutional, and industry stakeholders. A proactive, resourceful personality with strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail. Ability to turn fragmented market information into clear strategies, priorities, and actions. Excellent written and spoken English. French, Spanish, Portugeuse, or another European language is a strong plus. Experience in Earth observation, space, geospatial intelligence, government markets, water management, agriculture, climate technology, or deep tech is preferred. Willingness to travel internationally. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Manager, Strategy & Business Planning
items.summary: Do you love new ideas and look to improve the world in ways big and small?
items.description: Do you love new ideas and look to improve the world in ways big and small? How you’ll make a difference The Manager, Strategy & Business Planning formulates, leads, and achieves impact of strategy approaches supporting future organization direction and strategies. Drives growth by developing and implementing strategies to deliver “break-through” business models and innovation within our core offerings. Partners extensively with regions and central functions to drive business growth, planning and alignment while delivering competitive and market intelligence insights. In addition to common responsibilities identified below, individual roles will focus on Business Planning, Regional Support, and Competitive and Market Intelligence programs to drive growth and impact. This role may also support and/or lead corporate development (e.g., M&A, JV, Strategic partnerships) activities as needed. What you’ll bring to the role Bachelor’s degree related in finance, accounting, or other highly quantitative discipline or field(s) related to responsibilities. MBA or equivalent experience desired. Minimum of 7 years’ experience in a strategic role (corporate strategy, corporate finance, consulting, investment banking), with demonstrated experience in driving identification and understanding of key market information to support strategy design, business planning, and decision-making. Experience with international business development; working with global teams. Deep experience developing and designing implementation plans to drive execution. Experience in dealing with sensitive, confidential materials and respect for same, with ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive organization topics and issues. International experience with sensitivity to cultural differences is highly desirable. Demonstrated ability to identify and define business questions and issues, and develop strategic, analytical and financial frameworks to conduct analysis. Creative, out-of-the-box thinker who is intellectually curious with a demonstrated interest in continued learning. Expertise with an array of analytical methods in strategic analysis, market research, and financial modeling. Demonstrated strategy development and corresponding business results. Ability to balance other business considerations. Success in balancing service orientation with need for assertive or persuasive approach. Strong leadership skills, including sound business judgement in assessing and prioritizing competing priorities, as well as demonstrated positive relationship building across diverse cultures and backgrounds. Demonstrated ability to create and apply performance metrics. Strong verbal and written communication skills and finesse, including experienced and polished facilitator, public speaking to small and large groups, as well as ability to give corporate and public presentations. Highly developed organization, planning and management skills with ability to think ahead and plan over a five (5) year horizon. See the big picture while attending to details. Ability and willingness to become thoroughly familiar with project management, the profession, and PMI to command the respect of the organization’s constituencies. Travel up to 50% What you can expect from us We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Your health, safety and well-being come first, and we believe that you should have time for your work, but you should also have time for you.. Join us and you’ll get: an excellent total package, with compensation and benefits based upon your geographic location. skill development opportunities, to help you grow now and into the future. access to a global network, to enrich your professional experience. flexible options to help balance work time and your time award and bonus opportunities. The salary offer will be based on several factors, including the candidate’s demonstrated skills, qualifications and relevant experience. Let’s help make the world work better for everyone. Apply today! items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Summary We are seeking an experienced Roblox Developer or small development team to build a polished Roblox experience from concept through launch. The experience will be promoted to a large kids-and-families audience, with a strong focus on engagement, scalability, and player retention. General information This project is being developed for two major social media creators with a combined audience of 20M+ followers. The Roblox experience is expected to be heavily promoted across their social platforms, so the build needs to support a high-quality player experience and scale effectively as adoption grows. The role covers end-to-end ownership across product planning, development, launch support, and post-launch iteration. This is initially a project-based engagement, with potential for ongoing development and support if the initial launch performs well. Tasks and Deliverables We are looking for a developer/team that can own the project A–Z, including: Game concept and gameplay planning Roblox Studio development Map/world design 3D assets and environments Luau scripting Core gameplay mechanics Multiplayer systems UI/UX Player progression and rewards Data saving Monetization systems Mobile, tablet, PC, and console optimization Testing, debugging, and QA Roblox publishing and launch support Analytics and performance tracking Post-launch updates and improvements Required experience Strong portfolio of published Roblox experiences Deep experience with Roblox Studio and Luau Experience building games designed for large player counts Strong understanding of retention, progression, monetization, and Roblox game loops Experience optimizing Roblox experiences across devices Able to take ownership of both the technical development and overall product Strong communication and project-management skills Experience launching and maintaining successful Roblox games is highly preferred To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-pt-ft-senior-roblox-developer-game-designer

Collaborating with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, you’ll inspire cross-functional teams, develop human-centered creative strategies, and help build a scalable design practice rooted in experimentation, feedback, and continuous improvement.

items.title: AI Lead Creative
items.summary: Superside is looking for a Lead Creative with a passion for Generative AI to shape creative excellence across branding, landing pages, ads, social, print, and presentations. You’ll guide a global team of top-tier creatives, combining strategic leadership with hands-on craft to deliver human-centered, high-impact work for leading brands worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of creativity and innovation, elevating creative quality while helping evolve our capabilities through the thoughtful use of AI tools. You’ll act as both a mentor and a maker, fostering collaboration, empathy, and clarity across every project. You bring curiosity, composure, and humility to your leadership, helping others grow while delivering consistently outstanding creative work.

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.
